We are in the home stretch of our campaign against Josh Hawley, and recent polls show that this is just a 4 point race.
**Will you forward this email to your family and friends to let them read more about who I am and what I 'm fighting for in this election?** We still have time the close the gap and win this race -- but only if we have the people-power and resources to keep spreading our message across Missouri.
* * *
"I'll be alright," I said, flinching as I put a bag of ice on my shin and leaned back against a Jeff City High School locker.
Coach looked down at me and pursed his lips.
"I'll be right back," he said
Two minutes later he returned and held something down to me.
I looked at his hand and back to his face, confused. It was one of those paper concession stand Coca Cola cups.
"Thanks, Coach..." I said, "but..." I nodded toward my water bottle.
He lifted the cup back up to himself and brought his other hand up to it, tilting the cup sideways as he did so. Sitting right below him, I jerked instinctively, expecting the water to pour down on me. But nothing happened.
Bemused, I watched as Coach tore the rim off the cup about three inches down. Then I laughed at myself. The water inside was frozen. With the rim torn off, it looked like a giant push pop sticking out of the tattered end of the cup.
"This won't fix things, but it's a little more effective," Coach said, "Do it like this." And he rubbed the icy end up and down his arm then handed it back down to me.
"We'll figure this out," he added, and walked away.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/66c1648a-9197-43c2-94af-c073ebc3d820?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas and Teammates, Waynesville, Missouri_
It was the fall of 1998 and we were a third of the way through my junior season of high school cross country. For the first time in my running life, I was injured. But I knew that Coach, who had been there from my first high school run, really would do everything he could to figure it out.
Just like my academics, my Lewis and Clark Middle School athletic career had been entirely unremarkable. I'm pretty sure the middle school coaches only knew who I was because I had gotten my ear-pierced in seventh grade and my mom gave them hell when they made me take it out and it grew over.
I only decided to run cross country freshman year because my super cool older cousin, who lived in O'Fallon, Missouri, had come to Jefferson City for the state cross country meet a few years before and I wanted to be like him. I also really didn't have anything else to do that fall.
_**What a decision. **_
On my first run, I paired up with a guy named R and we were given directions on where to run. It could not have been longer than three miles, but we had to stop and walk several times. We would have walked a lot more except that the girls team left on the same route a few minutes after we did and, after their leaders tormented us as they flew by, we didn't want to be caught walking by the rest of them as they all caught up and passed us.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/975e5f3e-e85a-4fb5-8654-46d7b785faff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas, 9th Grade Jeff City Jay and Royals fan_
By the first meet, Coach had us freshman to a point where we could at least run the full two miles of the freshman course. And midway through the season he had us on the occasional slow run with older guys, who we both worshiped and were terrified of.
They were crazy fast -- under Coach's leadership we had become one of the top teams in the largest division in the state -- and they were also just plain crazy. They would pick up discarded beer cans on long country runs and drink whatever was left in them. They chewed dip when no one was looking and gave us nicknames like "Buddy," "Daisy," and "Ep." They tried to name me "Dammit," like, "dammit run faster" or "dammit get over here," but Coach didn't let it stick and likewise shot down more offensive labels related to the pronunciation of my last name, which kind of just happens on its own sometimes.
By the end of freshman year Coach had me running 5k in under 18 minutes, which wasn't half bad. I might have been a varsity runner if we hadn't been state champions that year.
I tore through sophomore season and aspired to be an all-state runner like so many of the older guys. Despite leading a team that was ranked as high as 13th in the nation that year, Coach took the time to make a plan for me so that I could make it happen the next year. The summer before junior year I crushed the miles like never before and just knew we were going to make it happen.
The first couple of meets made me even more certain. But then, as the mileage piled up, my shins started to break down. I'd never experienced shin splints before, so I ignored it at first, as something I could just run through.
This, of course, just made it worse. One day, Coach spotted me limping during a workout and immediately stopped me. I took the next day off, but it didn't make a difference.
Shortly after he gave me the ice cup, Coach came up with a new plan to at least keep me in the mix. He got me access to the YMCA across the street from the high school. Until things got better, I ran in the deep end of the pool with a floaty belt every morning before school and was either back in the pool or on a bike each afternoon.
I spent the rest of the season in and out of the pool. A doctor told me that my feet were different sizes, so maybe I could try getting the right size for each rather than splitting the difference. This came across as pretty ridiculous given that my parents could only afford one pair of shoes for the entire summer and fall as it was and everything I earned went toward gas, lunch, and saving for my future beater so that I could get to work and school on my own. I told Coach about it and we instead tried some inserts. They didn't do much.
Coach's pool regime worked fairly well. I ran the post-season that year and helped our team medal at the state meet. And although I didn't make all-state, I had a good showing for a guy who hadn't run in over a month, and scored in a year where we won a 4th place State trophy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7cb4f0c0-efe7-4ba1-9cee-eea2d7fac784?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas and Jeff City Jays 1998 Cross Country, 4th Place State_
As senior year came around and I amped up my mileage that summer, I freaked out at every twinge in my shin. I told Coach about it and he told me to ice early and often and not to worry about it, he would take care of things, and he gave me the occasional morning off so I wouldn't get too worn down. I began the year even better than the year before, but the nagging thought that the mileage would catch up was always there.
I brought it up again and Coach looked at me firmly and said, "Lucas, don't worry about it. I've got it figured out."
A couple weeks later he asked me to stay after practice. So I did. He avoided eye contact with me as everyone else headed out. I started to develop that knot in my stomach that you get when you know you're in trouble for something. I wondered what it could be.
He waited until everyone was gone. Then he called me over to the storage closet in the hallway where he could talk without anyone overhearing us. My stomach churned. What could it be?
Coach turned toward me as I walked through the door. I guess I was going to find out the hard way.
"I want you to have these," he said quietly, "but you can't tell anyone. Do you understand?"
"Huh?"
"I've been tracking your miles. You need to change your old ones out. But I know... well... everyone's situation is different. Just take these and don't tell anyone."
He shoved a cardboard box into my hands and walked out, not waiting for me to say thank you or see what it was. As he walked away I looked down.
It was a new pair of running shoes. Later that fall, injury free, I proudly posed for the Jefferson City News Tribune photographer on the grounds of Oak Hills Golf Course for a photo after the state track meet, wearing my hard-earned all-state medal. Captain of the Jefferson City High School Cross Country Team.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7c596df6-14f4-485e-95e0-f8c72e9f1787?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Lucas, All-State 4A Cross Country, 1999, wearing Coach 's shoes_
I never would have achieved that without Coach. I may have never made it to Yale without those credentials. That simple act, which was probably against some rule somewhere that makes life harder for people without money, likely changed the course of my life. And it's not like he did it from a place of comfort. He was a middle school teacher and high school coach in a state that pays its teachers poorly.
The coaches and the teachers in this state know our kids.
They know our dreams, our weaknesses, and our needs.
They invest in us.
I saw it first-hand through my mom, who taught middle school at Eugene Cole R-V and spent what little she could scrape together on supplies to improve that classroom for the kids there when she barely had enough for her kids at home. Eventually she had to quit because she basically wasn't making any money and my disabled little sister needed her support.
These heroes sacrifice every day for the next generation of Missourians and our politicians, in turn, have rewarded them with the lowest teacher pay in the country. And now, in order to save money, many Missouri school districts are only open four days a week, making the challenge for our teachers and coaches even harder.
If we don't start investing in our teachers and coaches soon, there won't be anyone left to invest in our kids. And that's going to be a lot less opportunity for all of us.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e6432b87-7037-47c6-b7d3-6c89db37465d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Thank you to all of the coaches and teachers who invested in me so that I could achieve my potential and dreams_

Dear Peter,

I hope I’m not cutting into your day, but I need to hear from you ASAP on what your plans are for this election.

You see, we’re now less than a month out from one of the most critical elections our nation has ever seen!

So, I’m doing a digital head count of every pro-lifer I know to help me gauge grassroots energy and better focus our resources!

Will you please fill out this brief PRO-LIFE TURNOUT PLEDGE right away
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NA8pMI9NJfSV6igjxi4IQQ~~/AAVkMwA~~~
?

Peter, all I’d like to know is:

A. Whether you’ve already voted early (either by mail, absentee ballot, or in-person);

B. Whether you plan to vote early (either by mail, absentee ballot, or in-person) if you haven’t yet; or

C. Whether you plan to vote in-person on Tuesday, November 5th.

It should take just a second or two to fill out!

With everything at stake in November, there’s no time to waste and no effort we can spare!

If you can vote early, please do!

Information on who has voted early is public.

So, voting early keeps resources from being wasted to turn out your vote.

If pro-lifers don’t FIGHT with everything we’ve got, the Abortion Lobby could succeed in forcing abortion-on-demand, up until (and even after) birth, on every state in the country – all paid for by hard working taxpayers like you and me!

To help Students for Life Action keep ALL our election plans running through election day, please complete your PRO-LIFE VOTER TURNOUT PLEDGE by clicking the link below:

Hello,
It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.
On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.
At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers.
We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.
The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.
So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.
But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win.
So 5 years after the day that changed my and my brother’s lives, I am asking you to support my pro-democracy movement and protect this seat from my extremist opponent.

Will you join me in supporting state Democrats nationwide by investing in the DLCC? | | | | | ---|--- Hi there – With only eight days until the October 16th FEC deadline, I’m reaching out with a critical message: Progress is possible but not guaranteed. Now more than ever, the DLCC and state Democrats are relying on your support to elect Democratic leaders who will protect our fundamental freedoms and secure a brighter future for all Americans. Over the past few months, it’s become clear: Something is happening in our country. You can feel it. It’s something we've worked for and dreamed of for a long time – hope has returned to our politics. I feel hopeful that with ongoing hard work, we will secure victory up and down the ballot this fall, and stop the spread of Trumpism to preserve our democracy. But we have a long road ahead. Even without Trump in the White House, Republicans have continued to relentlessly threaten our freedoms to make our own decisions about our health, our lives, our loves, and our families, yielding their razor-thin majorities in states like Arizona to pass far-right legislation. But if we come together to elect state Democrats this November, we can loosen Republicans’ tight grip on our legislatures and block their extreme agenda. Here’s the bottom line: It takes a village to heal a country, so I am calling on you to do your part ahead of this election. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: First to Fight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by End Citizens United-Nonfederal
body:
In Iraq, I had my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. I’ll fight it out on my own if I have to, but I’m not afraid to ask for help when I need it.
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22245%2E4449941%2EZSPW6z)
---
Team — Ruben. Personal note from me today, before tonight’s deadline.

It’s hard to shake the feeling that something’s wrong.

I’m not sure what it is, but you can always tell when something bad’s going to happen. I’ve got to tell you — right now, it feels like something’s off. I keep hearing about how this Senate race is locked up, that Kari Lake’s as good as defeated. I’m not seeing that.

You can’t escape the attack ads out here. Every time you turn on the TV they’re on. Trump’s got his eyes firmly fixed on Arizona, and Elon Musk is spending millions of his own money on get-out-the-vote efforts here. Kari Lake is still a threat, and don’t forget — she only lost by a few thousand votes last time.

And at the same time, our own fundraising... it’s not good. Without giving too much away here, we’re looking at big cuts because we’re not pulling in as much as we hoped we would. All of that adds up.

Marines have an old motto: “First to Fight.” In Iraq, we’d use special knocks to identify friend from foe when we were surrounded by insurgents. The comfort was knowing your friends were with you, that you had each other’s back. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/53953?t=7&akid=22245%2E4449941%2EZSPW6z) **In Iraq, I had my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. I’ll fight it out on my own if I have to, but I’m not afraid to ask for help when I need it.**

My team is facing a critical deadline coming up tonight, I’m knocking. I need your help. Please. [**Can I count on you to make a split donation ($10, or anything, really) with Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats before tonight’s deadline? We’ve got to keep the pressure on. This is too important.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/53953?t=8&akid=22245%2E4449941%2EZSPW6z) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/53954?t=9&akid=22245%2E4449941%2EZSPW6z)

clean_body: Join us on October 10 | | | ---|--- Peter, Save the date! On Thursday, October 10, I invite you to and make your mark on the fight for reproductive rights. Donor-advised fund (DAF) giving from advocates like you powers everything we do at the Center for Reproductive Rights. When you contribute to the Center through your donor-advised fund, you support urgent litigation, advocacy, and policy efforts while receiving an immediate tax deduction. Do you have a donor-advised fund? If so | "COMMIT TO A DAF GIFT" Step 1. Commit Make a commitment to give to the Center from your DAF on October 10th. Step 2. Plan Be bold. Could you give 5% or 10% of your DAF to support reproductive rights at this crucial moment? Step 3. Share Challenge your network to give through their DAFs along with you. DAF giving is easy, impactful, and even has tax benefits for you! Before DAF Day on October 10, please check with your financial advisor and make a plan to support the Center with your DAF gift. Sincerely, Gabriella Morris Chief Development Officer P.S. If you have any questions, you can get or contact us directly at mailto:contribute@reprorights.org. The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. **Dr. Ruiz needs our help to continue fighting for us in Congress and to flip the House blue this November.**

| Team—it’s Jon. Can I have a moment of your time? It’s important.

Voting has already started in Montana—and there are just 27 days until Election Day. _This is it._

**If you’ve been waiting for the best time to make a donation to win this Senate race, that time is right now.**

[**Make a split donation of $10 before midnight to help me fight back against Mitch McConnell’s attacks, reach as many Montana voters as we can, and win this race.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81495?t=6&akid=17361%2E878179%2EWoT7nd) | [CHIP IN »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81502?t=7&akid=17361%2E878179%2EWoT7nd)
---
When I was a kid, I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident in my family’s butcher shop. I don’t even remember putting my hand in there—but I can damn sure remember pulling it out.

But here’s the truth: You don’t need ten fingers to know right from wrong.

My multimillionaire opponent Tim Sheehy is wrong for Montana. He wants to return health care to “pure privatization”, rip away women’s freedom to choose, and transfer off our public lands.

Tim Sheehy is a rich out-of-stater who doesn’t know the first thing about Montana values. But he’s already dropped $2.5 million of his personal wealth to defeat me, and this race is too close for comfort.

[**Election Day is almost here, and I need your help to fight back against his attacks. Split any amount now to help me continue defending our Montana way of life »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81495?t=8&akid=17361%2E878179%2EWoT7nd)

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=4491%2E552475%2Emu87fO)
I know it’s late, Peter, but I just got off The Last Word With Lawrence O’Donnell, and I wanted to share my message with you.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241008-5?recurring=1&refcode=em20241008-5&refcode2=4491_552475_mu87fO&akid=4491%2E552475%2Emu87fO)
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241008-5?recurring=1&refcode=em20241008-5&refcode2=4491_552475_mu87fO&akid=4491%2E552475%2Emu87fO)**
**Our Senate majority will be won or lost right here in Pennsylvania** , and we won’t be in a good position to win unless we turn our fundraising around.
Here’s why: National Republicans are spending more money in Pennsylvania than in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Arizona _combined_.

Friends,
I’ve said this before, but it bears repeating: My opponent is so extreme that I generally don’t believe in giving his offensive ideas free exposure (or subjecting my supporters to them!).
More often than not, his fringe ideology is beyond reasonable discussion and is frankly better off ignored while we focus on the actual issues facing American families.
But earlier tonight, I joined my opponent in a candidate forum to talk about our priorities and where we stand on the issues – and I think it’s worth taking a moment to talk about what Bill Wells really believes.
He’s made it perfectly clear:
He is eager to demonize people who are seeking a safer life for themselves and their families in order to push an extreme right-wing anti-immigrant rhetoric.
He believes that climate change is a hoax that the government is using to control people.
He thinks marriage equality should be overturned, outlawing the fundamental right to marry the person you love.
He doesn’t think anyone should be able to access abortion care, for any reason. (Put another way: He thinks every woman and girl in the country should be forced to carry every pregnancy to term, even if they’ve experienced rape or incest, or if their health or future fertility is at risk. )
He’s a devoted follower of Donald Trump, whose xenophobic, misogynistic, egotistical politics are pushing the GOP down a dangerous path toward authoritarianism – and he still won't admit Trump lost the 2020 election.
This is who Bill Wells is.
Think about that for a minute – really think about what it would mean to have someone who holds these beliefs responsible for fighting for YOUR best interests.
Where is the compassion? Where is the faith in the values that our country was founded on? The belief that our diversity makes us great, and that everyone deserves the freedom and opportunity to thrive?
I am 100% confident that my opponent’s values do not reflect our district. I know the people in our community. They want representation rooted in integrity, policy backed by science, and inclusive, thoughtful leadership.
Bill Wells is an out-of-touch extremist. And here’s the thing – I’m determined to defeat him and win re-election. But that’s not enough. We need to send a message to him and to every extremist around the country that this is not who we are.
We can do that by delivering *resounding* victories at the ballot box in just 28 days.
If you’ve already received your mail-in ballot, I urge you to fill it out and return it ASAP, or go vote early in person ( find a location here [https://www.sdvote.com/content/rov/en/VotingOptions.html] ).
And if you can, I’m asking you to support my re-election campaign with a donation today so I can win big on November 5th. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you for reading, and for your support. I’m in this work because of you, and I’m proud to work on your behalf every single day.
Sincerely,
Sara
If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] And if you can’t give at all, I understand. I appreciate you taking the time to read these emails and stay connected with my campaign – regardless of whether or not you’re able to chip in financially. Thank you!

More often than not, his fringe ideology is beyond reasonable discussion and is frankly better off ignored while we focus on the actual issues facing American families. But earlier tonight, I joined my opponent in a candidate forum to talk about our priorities and where we stand on the issues – and I think it’s worth taking a moment to talk about what Bill Wells really believes. He’s made it perfectly clear: He is eager to demonize people who are seeking a safer life for themselves and their families in order to push an extreme right-wing anti-immigrant rhetoric. He believes that climate change is a hoax that the government is using to control people. He thinks marriage equality should be overturned, outlawing the fundamental right to marry the person you love. He doesn’t think anyone should be able to access abortion care, for any reason. (Put another way: He thinks every woman and girl in the country should be forced to carry every pregnancy to term, even if they’ve experienced rape or incest, or if their health or future fertility is at risk. ) He’s a devoted follower of Donald Trump, whose xenophobic, misogynistic, egotistical politics are pushing the GOP down a dangerous path toward authoritarianism – and he still won't admit Trump lost the 2020 election. Where is the compassion? Where is the faith in the values that our country was founded on? The belief that our diversity makes us great, and that everyone deserves the freedom and opportunity to thrive? I am 100% confident that my opponent’s values do not reflect our district. I know the people in our community. They want representation rooted in integrity, policy backed by science, and inclusive, thoughtful leadership. Bill Wells is an out-of-touch extremist. **Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._gIK84l28SrO5K3xk9c04Q)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._qTxA)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---
Faith & Liberty PO Box 455 Leesburg, VA 20178 If you no longer wish to receive sponsored promotional emails from us [_click here_](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/uu/3/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjgzLWVhMTdiM2Q1MDc5YjQ0ODJhZGEwYzcxYzk3NzdhY2I3IiwibSI6ZmFsc2V9/pm7ZRG_8qoDk04k8XAhDHQ) to unsubscribe.

## Masses Evacuate as Milton Barrels Toward Florida
Hurricane Milton forced major evacuations across central Florida on Tuesday as it heads toward landfall tonight with sustained winds of 165 mph.The massive hurricane is heading directly for Tampa and St Petersburg but is so big that officials have issued [mandatory evacuation orders](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fy6yAQQNGvgQ7PsuyzpILiNeqcNqUGw8raBAkNwvLk7zNJnfoWd877bboFybI93sLKvs1lCrHJyZMFMxikiXTyMzOy0-xthz31DjunF38d7jF2jiMhU5cgIQ7RBer_ueRiz1o8ApIFGCxAj_ZyB5si0N0RQxwoKAJO0kq9fBTZ2sJz_ion10ssq85-aW0_lPuvcFQ4hn3j1_GTFI5ZTlY4Ls9aJYaNzSq5lc3MuVRJwbQa4idX89xTaHzo6tP-kpzluHaK4LEGyb-X9rf59PgdAAD__43zWqM) for 11 Florida counties, covering nearly 6 million people. Fleeing residents [caused traffic jams](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GO6yAQAL8GuljLsglQULzGXV57pYVhHRNhY9nI1v39KVdfN9JII83Xc3iGXPL6-h8W9m2qQ4gtnzwouLkb0kAy-YkZWUv2yqAlq9FoOXuyITgNIVhzT_Gug40PdSc96ochx0lmj4CkAJwCsKi6EVSKQKMmhugoCAJOudW9e9e8tpmn8l1P3rtYF1n83Np2CP1PYC-wv66rG8f4cQL7la9DYH_mxPUD0ent7awp-qxy92m7cin5eBhB8FpCLr_N9vfh6fEnAAD__4NeUa0) in the Tampa area, while elsewhere people boarded up homes and businesses and shelters have been set up around the state. Estimates of potential damage are as high as $175 billion.Florida's tourism industry [also made preparations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuSpCAUxvGnwQwLD7SXgGATs950Q4vLsT07CBag1rz9VM-kk36_5Kv_v-fyNBQovv6aHXVd02JcpQuXTvCJg1pU4_WKCCgb1N0AoxolDLLZtOjHdZJ2sF7COj1W63sB8mGntfcO1dCQBgGqE2LqhBiha63ovBPKSoXCTcowJdBTTbn9nyjWDdfwmS7MrUt7E_RW61GY_MNgZjDf991G6yLe5e0MZnsWilgKg7lmc2FgMBvK4T3yuuGO_DD5o3CXTyrIf2A7cyZnIvKdQk2Reyr5PCqlWHh20XSDUuPYZO2Pm0Kg0g9MidduKHwfq79nujR8BQAA__8Avm1V) for the storm as airlines canceled hundreds of flights, theme parks closed, and cruise lines shifted routes.
## States Sue TikTok Over Youth Addiction

Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7oiWZWNDQXFNulx7pYVhiblgE9mbRPn7U65-5Wia0fy5TtdQatluv8PKXnKbQpTy4kmDcgppoj75zIxsevZ6REvW4Gj6xWfNRsdxMOYMA-PMkaOhYOg8W-vQ9sUjIGkApwEs6tMMOkWg2RBDdBQ6Ak5F2n7628omC-f6aS_eT7GtffWLyOPozK8OLx1ewmPj9_FVX9ilxModXqTcpd1VDe_jWUR92lMWtfImoaqFQ5VFoXMmWx4hIZtEHGbnrE1ZDzbPjmy_-_R4l1rLMYwdwW0Npf5vkJ-PvDz-CwAA___vx2JA), alleging that the platform is intentionally designed to be addictive to children and harm their mental health.Launched in 2016, the [Chinese-owned](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FugzAQgOGnsTfQ-XwEGDx0YUvXjsjYR7hicAQuVd--aufMv_RL38d9vHtJsj_e_cauzHn0ocjFo4Gqr5BG0tHNzMhWszMtdtRZbK1enIkd-Mazj8ZGImx8F41hCma-YeRGi0NAMgC9AejQ1BOYGIAmSwyhJ68IOErJR_2ZZS8Lz-knX3zUIW86uaWU56nsm8JB4TD5sCbZ1_xXFQ5F1pLX6uvk49SHi89vSUnOW6sIHpuX9H8pr02Xw98AAAD__78MTrc) ## World's Longest Treasure Hunt Ends
The world's longest treasure hunt for a [gold, silver, and diamond-encrusted "Golden Owl"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1y6yAQQOGnkbr1LAv6Kyhu4863TalZiZVEBoEHsD3O02eSOvVpznwft_nGPvi4_-dTbN3SzGv1T5kVwgRkZtM6u4mQ6FasGmg0o6ZBt4cdccSBF61G7jdybFbpNtd3m9ELOxpabwnJKMRJIY6kLgsqt6JZtBFcJ8ONQXG-pnz5TD7WQ7bwTk_JlzWdbbBHrffS6H8NXRu67v7rTC79tIaur5SDKxBS3KVUqFm4PLLA8YgVJLoCvFXJoBW8hXOBDs4U61GAo4MJHL8LECJ22E84ttm6-8uH4Es_NAb3k3343ah_ozwtfQcAAP__3H1kVA) statue worth $165,000 has come to an end after 31 years, 5 months, and 9 days.The hunt began in 1993 when French author Regis Hauser hid the bejeweled owl statuette, challenging participants to solve 11 puzzles and codes in his book _On the Trail of the Golden Owl_. You can try [the cryptic puzzles here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFv8yAQgOFfAxvR3YECHhi-xVu-taNF4LCpCEQ2cdR_X7Vz91ev9HzcllsotbT1f3iwH7kvIY5y8oKgJkVmMTL5zEysJXu05IzTZLXcfEjW6fvVOZfsFK8624RsIGNGBANWFk9ABgEmBHCElztgimDu2jDEyQRhgFMZfb989tLGxrl-9ZP3S-wPWf02xvMQ-p-gWdC89pq49XfdXm38FILmUKtCVLG--FC9qd5YPcPKgma5-_R8l1rLcbXCwPoIpf6Ox9_M09N3AAAA__9MHlPu).Hauser, the only one who knew [the owl's location](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFv8yAQgOFfgzes47gEe2D4Fm_51o4WMeeYikCEL7b676t27vwOr56P23wLKafy-B-e7GWtc1gkHTwb0KNGmqmLfmVGth1743CgwaKz3eavdF-HCIN1ZjAOwfHCLq7WMC0UOHTJIyAZgNEADGj6O5i4AN0tMSwjBUXAMUlt_WdNRTZe81c9uPVLfXbZbyKvXdl_CieFU-Fz70OTwvLTFU6hiT5ry1Hh9Kg5ctH1zFoah_3dWG_vInqt7xI1XmiE66VrPr7OlHPar04RPJ4h5d-b_G0_PH4HAAD__x7MXA0), died in 2009, leading to a legal battle between his heirs and co-creator Michel Becker.Becker announced last week that a [random participant](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3oiOg8TOwNCFLV07WtgcMS0xEZwT-d9X7tz5-_T09L5u482nnNb7p3-Q5VhGP3N60ahAXiWa0XTBRiIk3ZFVPQ5m0NjrbrHqEv0cIfRhiH3UMfbaAJhJz5NWKvouWQQ0CuCqAAZUpwlUmI-HIZivxgsDFBKXevouaeWFYt7Li-ppLo8u24X52YT-EOgEunV_lsbHJNAdYIFOgUAHZ4Eup0iN90wCHVfybaskl21lGUuVXk5bTRRkY88byXepvEhfy7YGqS7nH0lraNJHpiq1kjv52gS6rtrwfKecU7v0wsD94VP-s-P_W70s_gYAAP__hY9rcw), whose identity remains unknown, had solved the puzzle and uncovered the owl. A suspicious package and a bomb threat forced authorities to [evacuate the Saudi Consulate in Houston](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQRb_GdI7MxNihcPEaurx2SzR4HBitwSy2s9m_X5F-q1sc6ejqfNzHO3Lkbf6Pa3Dl9Ugj-sLPMLZK9hL0qBtyk6K-bYJrLdy0NQBdszjdT6A9wFUZo6xVHXVokMLDWq-0hoYdKNCtUn2rOgPd5QoGYCKcbtBbNCS0CsQlHZeyhBJemB_xJz3DcfFpbaJbStmzuP4TMAgYlpQo8hZOKGA43QKGVr1RzSVtck-RfZC4kZzSOsn8VZHkEfKeNpIlyVzzzp5TzXJH_4lzkFjkVDkSb7M8PedmrMTSpy3XiCUIGJrD0f7NMXI2Vmg1r8jxfbP8Ue3p4DcAAP__DTdw_g) and a Galveston synagogue on Monday, a year to the day after Hamas terrorists attacked Israel. Authorities didn't find any explosives nearby and learned that other Jewish places of worship had received a similar email. The one-year anniversary of the deadly attack was marked by vigils and protests across the country.
## Officials Push Austin-Monterrey Rail Line
Bexar County Judge Peter Sakai and Travis County Judge Andy Brown, along with several other officials from Texas and Mexico, took a ride on Amtrak's Texas Eagle last week to promote the [construction of a high-speed rail line](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwAdsUFK9xl9duaRG4ia-EwTJsnPz9Kim22240GmmOztdluXhKlO___YauPW9l8aHRAxcpuOWgF91FdxXRyg6dHGHS4wBgutUZq4OK-gY4TpMyQgc_aDkJJZUQGKAjBwK0FMJKYQYwvYIB4Br9dQI7-iEyLTBSK0ffVmz49PWWXuWBRx_K1iW3trZXpv4xmBnM53n226v67HMrmcp7xGDOeFYGs_-ujfI7HI1Cwt-Kb_ikUPjua8V8x4MfnhL_3HFpR2tAmX5f9-5wcT8pJarDyLS4b57Sh6T9Iebh4CcAAP__9WpmHQ) connecting Austin, San Antonio, Laredo, and Monterrey. ## Report: Texas Presidential Donations
Texans [gave a total of $39.6 million](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L9y4yAQgPGnQR0eWNC_guIadb72Ss1KiyzmkGBgrTh5-kzcp_4133z_7vMdQwzn4y8e3vFrSzOuHC4_ayVHCXa2DblF0agb73QPg-07gLbZnRk2a2lcDPnB6NWTGvoBjbWI2tCqm-BAgdVKjVq1HbQ3Ax3AQrgMMPbYkbDKU-BUbrx79i-sW_xMly-3NR1NdDtzrsL8ETAJmHBZtfkRAVNOlQVMe3pWTqfcU6QqOWX5FbJcE_kqt1QOX2QuvgbyJ0tKJ0aSXJ5HlldYvfyPB0aUO5YS6ts5pLMKmHRrhrG3nYCpKY7yR4gx1K4XVj0ODPEdyL_8uhx8BwAA__92cG7a) to the campaigns of former President Donald Trump and either President Joe Biden or Vice President Kamala Harris between Jan. 1 and Aug. 31 this year, according to Federal Election Commission data. Donations to Trump averaged $50.85, whereas those to Biden and Harris averaged $145.28. Biden and Harris raised the most from 10 Zip codes in Houston, Austin, and Dallas. The top 10 Zip codes for contributions to the Trump campaign are in Houston, Dallas, Austin, Boerne, San Antonio, Southlake, and Midland.

body:
Want to attend the MAGA rally in Aurora? Here’s how to get tickets to the big event
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, October 9, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Want to attend the MAGA rally in Aurora? Here’s how to get tickets to the big event](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Donald J. Trump, the 45th President of the United States and the Republican nominee to become the 47th President, will visit Aurora on Friday, Oct. 11, for a Make America Great Again rally.
The former President has announced he will deliver remarks at 1 p.m. at the Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center, 6700 N. Gaylord Rockies Blvd. A number of office-holders and Republican leaders could attend the rally and speak from the stage.
As is typically the case with any Trump campaign rally, it will be the hottest ticket in town. So how do you get a ticket?
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Supreme Court dismisses latest Masterpiece Cakeshop case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Supreme Court dismissed the latest Masterpiece Cakeshop case on procedural grounds, ruling that the plaintiff, Autumn Scardina, incorrectly filed her lawsuit in district court instead of the Court of Appeals.
* The lawsuit involved Christian baker Jack Phillips’ refusal to make a cake celebrating a gender transition, which had previously been ruled a violation of the Colorado Anti-Discrimination Act (CADA) by lower courts.
* The court's 4-3 decision avoided addressing the constitutional issue of free speech versus anti-discrimination protections, with the dissent criticizing the majority for sidestepping this significant question.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Forest Service closes Colorado caves to limit spread of bat disease that has killed millions of animals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. Forest Service has closed 88 caves in the Rocky Mountain Region, including 16 in Colorado, to prevent the spread of white-nose syndrome, a deadly disease that has killed millions of bats across North America.
* White-nose syndrome was found in 32 bats in Colorado this spring, marking a significant increase from previous detections, and is expected to spread further across the state.
* Cavers are working closely with biologists and land managers, helping to map caves, collect samples, and track bat populations, as well as aiding in conservation efforts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Grand Junction still seeking answers to homeless issue, following drug arrests at resource center](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Grand Junction approved zoning changes for temporary homeless shelters but excluded tents and safe parking over safety concerns.
* The Homeward Bound Resource Center has struggled with drug use and crime, leading to arrests and complaints from nearby businesses, including the Elks Lodge.
* Councilman Cody Kennedy criticized the center for enabling drug use and opposed further funding after it failed to meet its intended goals.
* The Elks Lodge reported safety concerns after a homeless man attacked a family at a recent event.
* Kennedy noted promising mental health programs like A Special Place, aimed at helping homeless individuals with mental illnesses.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[City cleanup, homelessness, public safety top Colorado Springs’ mayor’s budget priorities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NBC 5 KOAA-TV](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Springs Mayor Yemi Mobolade’s proposed 2025 city budget focuses on three top priorities: public safety, city cleanup, and addressing homelessness.
* The budget includes adding 20 police officers, a 2% raise for police and fire employees, and continued funding for homeless outreach teams.
* The city plans to allocate $500,000 for shelter bed operations and focus on affordable housing and service coordination through the Housing and Homelessness Response Department.
* Efforts to clean up the city include filling dump trucks with debris, removing abandoned vehicles, and addressing graffiti, with additional staff positions added for neighborhood park maintenance.
* The city council is expected to approve the budget in November.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[DeSantis blasts Kamala for Hurricane Milton comments: ‘She has no role in this process’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Florida Governor Ron DeSantis criticized Vice President Kamala Harris for calling him "selfish" regarding his handling of Hurricane Milton preparations.
* DeSantis emphasized that Harris has no role in the state's storm response and has not contributed to disaster efforts during her time as vice president.
* He noted that he is working closely with President Biden and FEMA, just as he did with previous presidents during natural disasters.
* DeSantis accused Harris of politicizing the storm for her campaign and stated that his focus remains solely on protecting the lives and property of Floridians.
* He dismissed her involvement as a political maneuver, claiming it was driven by her poor performance in the polls.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Kamala melts down after brief run-in with journalism on 60 Minutes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE SPECTATOR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Kamala Harris struggled during a 60 Minutes interview, where journalist Bill Whitaker asked challenging questions on issues like immigration, the economy, and the Middle East conflict.
* On immigration, Harris failed to provide clear answers when asked about the surge in illegal crossings under her administration, repeating vague statements and deflecting blame.
* Harris gave similarly vague responses on the U.S. influence over Israel during the Middle East conflict and on her economic policies, resorting to platitudes rather than substantive solutions.
* When pressed on her unclear political positions and lack of public trust, Harris offered broad statements about consensus-building but failed to address specific concerns.
* The interview exposed Harris's difficulty in handling tough questions, reinforcing concerns about her campaign and leadership capabilities as the election approaches.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Grabar: Kamala Harris is poised to revive the worst aspects of FDR’s socialist agenda](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARY GRABAR, [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_At the Economic Club of Pittsburgh, Democratic presidential candidate Kamala Harris recently said she would “engage in what Franklin Roosevelt called ‘bold, persistent experimentation,’” as he had told the 1932 graduating class at Oglethorpe University. But she did not mention FDR’s vision of “remaking the world,” which included fundamentally changing “our popular economic thought” to see to “a wiser, more equitable distribution of the national income.”_
_Instead, she said she would seek “practical solutions” and even declared, “I am a capitalist.” She said she’s “been working with entrepreneurs and business owners” for her “whole career.” (No one has yet even been able to verify Harris’ job at McDonald’s.)_

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[If you don’t know Danielle Jurinsky, you might after Donald Trump’s MAGA rally in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 8** _When Danielle Jurinsky returned to civilian life after nine years serving in the Air Force, most of it at Buckley Air Base, and after building multiple businesses employing more than 50 residents, adding to her responsibility may not have been a consideration._
**[Donald Trump delivers on promise to visit Mile High state, announces MAGA rally Friday in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 7** _Donald J. Trump is delivering on another promise for Coloradans.__The former President has announced a rally in which he will deliver remarks at 1 p.m. Friday, Oct. 11, at the Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center, 6700 N. Gaylord Rockies Blvd., in Aurora. Trump had repeatedly said he would visit the Front Range community during prior rallies._ __
**_[U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert listens to Western Slope leaders on energy, water and land use](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 7** _Meet Bryce and Lisa Casto, sixth-generation ranchers on the Western Slope, who are worried that the Dolores Monument designation will close their roads and leave them unable to care for their livestock. Bryce understands the importance of local communities managing the land around them._ __

body:

| [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001TEByiJ7-O4FtmTT0Na7hEJ47m1HML2zellpYhomULlmHq72knojdLvfu9wuuxa4KE36Mwo-Mz5c2qzKyxFDAbLxDBhDHpU980tYjtpCqePkIgAHcEj_TAFQx-uk9tyoyXn-OouJaxLkXPFAYZvx4Fw==&c=LUD75Z1oAnUrZarBXiKpr9Q6u17cLv54Ffy9KZvgCSnjylVlHIzoFw==&ch=kFpySUocQ7Mwr7ScJMxQXanpDV1cA1X4MH5D3UcS6CjQoYUQD2sSsA==)
---
| The MassGOP Joins City Councilor Kelly Dooner in Calling for an Audit of EBT Cards
---
---
| Boston, MA- Thanks to a FOIA request by State Senate candidate for the 3rd Bristol and Plymouth District, Taunton City Councilor Kelly Dooner, it has been revealed that 672,483 new EBT cards were added to the welfare rolls in just 14 months--a staggering 34.6% increase over the past year. Following the release of these EBT figures, the Department of Transitional Assistance (DTA) disclosed more data, claiming they serve 1 million clients. However, there are currently over 2.6 million active EBT cards in the Commonwealth, raising serious concerns about accountability and oversight.
These numbers simply don't add up. The MassGOP stands with Kelly Dooner and Senate Republicans in calling on State Auditor Diana DiZoglio to conduct a thorough audit of EBT cards in Massachusetts. Accountability is long overdue.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on the recent revelation, stating, "The surge in EBT cards over the past 14 months is staggering. While the connection between the migrant influx and the 672,483 new EBT cards seems likely, we won't have the full picture until a comprehensive audit of the system is conducted."

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Let’s walk together along the path of Jesus Christ
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWv3JPJWNS
Many of us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus
Christ.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWv3JPJWNS

Hello
Friend,
Many of
us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But
have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?
In our
fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a
day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of
Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village
healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the
blind.
Jesus
didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of
about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone
His father put in His path.
To help
you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the
world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces
the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events
from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of
Olives
This
unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000,
walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with
Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will
better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he
confronted.

I pray it
will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area
of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see
what God has in mind.
Here's
your link to get the map and begin your journey of discovery:
https://ptv.org/nna/the-jesus-map

Let's
walk together along the path of Jesus Christ.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2035%2E135344%2EG_OoPJ)

Friends --
In just a moment, we are going to ask you to make a well-timed contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate in Michigan. Please give us a chance to explain why this request -- especially today -- is so important.
Here's the truth:
Last night was the first debate of the campaign.
We hope you watched it, but if you didn't, rest assured you would have been proud of Elissa.
Our opponent, Mike Rogers ... he had no answers for his previous support for abortion bans, raising the Social Security retirement age, and a host of other far-right positions.
But while it is pretty clear Elissa won last night's debate, debates on their own don't win elections. They help, but Elissa doesn't just get declared the winner because she did a better job last night.
Winning takes the work of volunteers, and it takes resources. Right now, we need the resources to reach the remaining undecided voters and to turn out infrequent Democratic voters.
That won't happen without your help. So while Elissa did her job last night, now she needs those of us who can to do our part:
[**Can Elissa count on you to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, directly to her campaign for U.S. Senate? As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we’re doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

| |

---
| | | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6n19le8ghkb60jv964fn8q1icc5bane9q6vcsh0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie4pj4clh2bs "Byron Donalds")
---

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z282cearujj8djakhsccrkon18b1i5g52m8i3lf8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie4pj4clh2bs "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zcnc8um4743h1ls1gb5aj8ag1mpbphsmkuhsj2go_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie4pj4clh2bs "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

I don't know about you but the thought of unified Republican control fires me up! If that doesn't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?

The Democrat Party is spending more money - and spending it earlier - than we've ever seen before. They know they are LOSING on the issues.

| _Flooding in Pajaro After Levee Breach_
With Hurricane Milton, a second Category 4 hurricane headed toward Florida, not only did Gov. DeSantis immediately declare a state of emergency for 51 counties, but at least one county, Pinellas, went further with their own local county order to evacuate all residential healthcare facilities which may be affected by the oncoming storm.

My pledge to you is that one of my priorities as member of Congress will be legislation that puts the majority of disaster preparedness funds accessible at the LOCAL LEVEL. Each community knows the type of disasters that are likely in their area and where to position assets to take care of the people.

# Watsonville—Abandoned by Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren
Lawmakers had long known that there was the potential for massive flooding along the Pajaro River that separates Monterey County from Santa Cruz County. It also separates Congressional District 19 from Congressional District 18. On March 13, 2023, the Pajaro Levee failed. There was massive flooding in the poor migrant community in Watsonville.
Gov. Newsom assured residents that he had spoken to President Biden and HELP WAS ON THE WAY.
A year and a half later, the levee on the Congressional 19 side is fixed. On the Congressional 18 side of the river, the levee is still broken, the land is still flooded...and Zoe Lofgren has totally forgotten about these poor migrant families.
---
| _Lofgren Presents Check for King City Electric Vehicle Charging Station_
As Ronald Reagan said, “The nine most terrifying words in the English language are ‘I’m from the government and I’m here to help.’”
Support me for US CONGRESS, Congressional District 18, and I will advocate for the majority of disaster preparedness funds be accessible at the local level.

| Regards,Peter Hernandez

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lateefah for Congress
body:
https://www.lateefahsimon.com [https://www.lateefahsimon.com]
Friend,
Lateefah Simon here. As a proud child of the Bay Area, I have dedicated my life to fighting for justice and equity, and now I am ready to take that fight to Washington. Will you join me in the fight by rushing a donation of $10, $20, or $50 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_061724_welcome_a]
Here’s my story. You see, Friend, from a young age, I was deeply committed to advocacy. At just 16, I began my career as an outreach coordinator for the Young Women’s Freedom Center.
At age 18, I gave birth to my eldest daughter, Aminah, and quickly learned as a young single mother that the government wasn’t working for people like me – leading me on the path to earning national acclaim for championing marginalized young women.
This work was recognized with a MacArthur “Genius” Fellowship, making me the youngest woman to ever receive this prestigious award at age 26.
My commitment to justice caught the attention of then-San Francisco District Attorney Kamala Harris, who invited me to lead the creation of Back on Track, a pioneering anti-recidivism initiative for young adults charged with low-level offenses. This program has become a model for effective, compassionate justice reform.
In 2016, driven by the tragic death of Oscar Grant, I ran for and was elected to the Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) Board of Directors. Born legally blind, I know firsthand the critical importance of reliable public transportation. My work at BART has focused on making transit more affordable and accessible for working families and transit-dependent people like myself.
Throughout my career, I have been a steadfast voice for Oakland and the Bay Area, serving numerous local organizations and advising state officials on policies related to racial justice. My life's work has always been about bringing the voices of our community to the forefront.
Now, I am taking the next step.
I am running for Congress because our community needs a fighter in Washington — someone who understands our struggles and is committed to advocating for us. For over 25 years, I’ve fought for civil rights and social justice in the Bay Area. I’ve seen the failures of a system that often ignores the needs of its most vulnerable citizens. Friend, I’m that fighter, and I will be that fighter for you in Washington.
I will bring our shared stories and experiences to the halls of Congress, advocating for communities of color, young single mothers, and young people navigating the underground street economy. Are you with me? Donate to my campaign today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_061724_welcome_a]

clean_body: [] Friend, Lateefah Simon here. As a proud child of the Bay Area, I have dedicated my life to fighting for justice and equity, and now I am ready to take that fight to Washington. Will you join me in the fight by rushing a donation of $10, $20, or $50 today? [] Here’s my story. You see, Friend, from a young age, I was deeply committed to advocacy. At just 16, I began my career as an outreach coordinator for the Young Women’s Freedom Center. At age 18, I gave birth to my eldest daughter, Aminah, and quickly learned as a young single mother that the government wasn’t working for people like me – leading me on the path to earning national acclaim for championing marginalized young women. This work was recognized with a MacArthur “Genius” Fellowship, making me the youngest woman to ever receive this prestigious award at age 26. My commitment to justice caught the attention of then-San Francisco District Attorney Kamala Harris, who invited me to lead the creation of Back on Track, a pioneering anti-recidivism initiative for young adults charged with low-level offenses. This program has become a model for effective, compassionate justice reform. In 2016, driven by the tragic death of Oscar Grant, I ran for and was elected to the Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) Board of Directors. Born legally blind, I know firsthand the critical importance of reliable public transportation. My work at BART has focused on making transit more affordable and accessible for working families and transit-dependent people like myself. Throughout my career, I have been a steadfast voice for Oakland and the Bay Area, serving numerous local organizations and advising state officials on policies related to racial justice. My life's work has always been about bringing the voices of our community to the forefront. Now, I am taking the next step. I am running for Congress because our community needs a fighter in Washington — someone who understands our struggles and is committed to advocating for us. For over 25 years, I’ve fought for civil rights and social justice in the Bay Area. I’ve seen the failures of a system that often ignores the needs of its most vulnerable citizens. Friend, I’m that fighter, and I will be that fighter for you in Washington. I will bring our shared stories and experiences to the halls of Congress, advocating for communities of color, young single mothers, and young people navigating the underground street economy. Are you with me? Dear Fellow Patriot,

The Supreme Court of the United States just announced they’re stepping in and taking up Mexico’s lawsuit against Smith & Wesson!

With this lawsuit, Mexico is suing an American gun manufacturer for Mexico's own failure to control the cartels who run their country.

Not only that, but Mexico is DEMANDING the Court issue a complete BAN _on production of AR-15 and AK-47 platform rifles and a list of all U.S. purchasers (you know, like you or me_)!

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court to help me stop this madness IMMEDIATELY](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=nw70oo21xva37w8vyc8o27huxaj4m1b59snr9jx81ggk51vvumgl0gd353ki4i7u3cwc48m5i80zvas6fc4n8mzblj50gy0d1wb1jm85w809114tkc8ua82kbk832enpa4imvbkszj3lvsty0799tt767pf76xp8c99rkw2p2fcgbt9q9ac88rmx0&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)**.

As you’ll see, this _CIVIS DIRECTIVUM_ – Latin for “Citizen’s Directive” – demands that the United States Supreme Court: **1)_Immediately dismisses the case_** , forbidding it from proceeding to trial; **2)_Sends a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message_** that _NO FOREIGN ENTITY_ will ever have standing to file lawsuits related to our Second Amendment freedoms in U.S. courts. PERIOD. It’s absolutely vital that you do so now.

Because if they don’t, it won’t be long until the United Nations gets their ultimate wish – which is the power to control the United States and our gun laws though the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty.”

And make no mistake.

That’s exactly what this lawsuit is about.

You see, Mexico -- a country that’s signed on to the UN’s anti-gun “Small Arms Treaty” -- is furious that disarming law-abiding citizens across Mexico has resulted in violent drug cartels controlling up to 35% of the country (_according to a 2022 U.S. Senate resolution_).

Instead of blaming their own draconian gun laws (_as they should_), Mexico is suing U.S. gun manufacturer Smith & Wesson.

But not for any __AMERICAN LAW__ any of these companies have broken...

Mexico is suing these gun manufacturers for supposedly “allowing” the guns they’ve built to be trafficked into the hands of Mexican criminals -- _as if there was any way the firearms industry could have predicted their firearms would be illegally trafficked_!

To no surprise, the Biden-Harris Administration and the gun grabbers at the United Nations are cheering it all on.

Make no mistake. This is a brazen attempt to get the UN's anti-gun "Small Arms Treaty" installed by the U.S. Supreme Court.

**That’s what this new legal assault is really all about**.

In fact, after this case was filed, two separate UN-affiliated entities filed _amicus curae_ briefs with the First Circuit.

Additionally, the United Nations’ Office on Drugs and Crime issued a statement: _“This case exemplifies the illicit nature of a firearm transfer in circumstances in which weapons could be used to commit human rights violations, which fits into the broader trend of engaging the concept of complicity in developing legal standards for corporate accountability.”_ This is right out of the UN “Small Arms Treaty” playbook, which includes laying the groundwork for: *****_ALL firearms manufacturers who seek to export firearms to ask for permission and report on how they believe the guns they sell will be used_.**

The UN ultimately wants final say on whether any firearms transfer should be allowed. After all, they know guns in the hands of the “wrong” people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; *****_ALL Treaty countries to allow firearms manufacturers to be sued for crimes committed with their products_.**

Imagine how outrageous it would be if Ford was sued because an F-150 owner ran a red light and caused a crash! That’s what the gun grabbers want to do with firearms because they know this could END gun manufacturing; and *****_That ALL countries involved in the export of firearms – including the United States – establish a “National Control System_.”**

This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple – the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION. Now, Mexico is demanding that arms manufacturers provide them with full information on every gun sale! This case shows how serious they are about forcing the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on the United States – _especially while they still have a puppet in the White House_.

The fact is, President Biden took an oath to “defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.”

As the Defendants in this case stated in a recent court filing: _“Mexico’s brazen attempt to regulate the American firearms industry based on its foreign interests poses a grave threat to the sovereignty of the United States, its citizens, and their Second Amendment rights.”_ But Joe Biden and Kamala Harris couldn’t care less – so long as it results in less freedom for you and me!

While Mexico is blaming Smith & Wesson for “allowing” guns to fall into the hands of drug cartels, _part of me wonders if it’s Biden’s ATF that’s truly to blame_.

You probably remember how, during the Obama Administration, the ATF launched Operation Fast and Furious, where they stood by silently, allowing guns sold in the U.S. to be illegally trafficked to Mexican gangs – _until U.S. Border Patrol agent Brian Terry was killed with one of those guns_.

**Would you put something like this past the Biden-Harris Administration?**

This is an administration who seems to want their legacy to be the complete and utter destruction of American freedom!

They _WILL_ get their way if I can’t count on your IMMEDIATE action.

But I’m counting on you to make sure we’re heard.

And the more signatures I can gather for this **[CIVIS DIRECTIVUM](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=nw70oo21xva37w8vyc8o27huxaj4m1b59tccs00n1jjwpzwg6lp234sspcrzhgk81m3o8qbbil9krtfwxiaex60szk9rzrqp1pnf48gwkf1lyjeh2e84h3ldezyf25kwkfg4wqy3dp80pwlwgc6jkpuuc9d0frizah3mxmawkomizn69n5ii2spb9&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)** , the louder our message will be when tens of thousands of American gun owners have their names presented before the U.S. Supreme Court.

Yes, Fellow Patriot, this case should be an open and shut one.

After the Supreme Court’s 2022 _Bruen_ decision, how could they possibly even think of siding with Mexico on this case?

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please fill out your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name presented – along with tens of thousands of other American patriots just like you – before the U.S. Supreme Court IMMEDIATELY](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=nw70oo21xva37w8vyc8o27huxaj4m1b5sb57489ttt5lj24gkgevw6bpln7k7u1nxk75ojojceml9lt9348vzarm5yw9nk7w04pmnm8sb7guq4l5wgmnargdt425j59t0ihi124h6fw8anfd6sszpchg7ccgng2mz805vh0qm5abavn6e1xphk3js&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)**.

Of course, in a perfect world, I wouldn’t have to ask you to do this...

But that’s not the one we live in.

_After all, you’ve heard how judges rule on the law and never take into account public opinion_.

But how many Supreme Court decisions can you rattle off the top of your head where justices got it completely backward?

The reason is that there are many judges who like to stick their fingers in the air to judge which way the political winds are blowing before they pick a side.

Worse, they often make those decisions based on what they see in the media and the swamp elites they rub shoulders with...

Fellow Patriot, it’s this bubble you and I have to break through.

**[That’s why your signed CIVIS DIRECTIVUM – along with a mountain of other signatures from Second Amendment supporters just like you – can help make all the difference](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=nw70oo21xva37w8vyc8o27huxaj4m1b5scwummawtw8y5a65zvmyysqd7jabkse1vtbdt3etdvwm5egyhmf10ve0fzaa4dx5lj01u8gi3ei901zuai9jhndwvfshiuianxfc1ceum9a9usnc0lqngz76cyazkaxbxfg06xyy5a8dyp81fue1bl71v&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)**.

But I hope you won’t stop there.

Given the stakes in this battle, I hope you’ll consider giving generously as well.

You see, to make the biggest and LOUDEST possible impact at the Supreme Court, I need to alert Second Amendment supporters across the country to this threat.

Needless to say, that won’t be cheap.

But we have no choice.

**The UN is NOT going to stop with destroying our Second Amendment freedoms, Fellow Patriot – as if that wasn’t bad enough**.

Disarming us is just the first step, so we’ll be powerless to stop the rest of their schemes they plan to impose on us.

You and I both know that.

**[So please sign your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court right away](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=nw70oo21xva37w8vyc8o27huxaj4m1b5sdlfsp3ztzn8qm7so7ebac44sw5tbrudt18pxm81emfx1y80ztpupr4dtaf2jwkdlbyeb7tnupjlxknhek9w27apyuhxhivhymdw2rs5pbemowfahuo0nvuv9uytxv54wrzgfo8g16efw74iglkbw0m5i&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)**.

This may be far more than you’ve ever given.

In fact, some members of my staff were concerned that asking you for that much might upset you.

Fellow Patriot, I certainly don’t want to upset you.

But I also know you’re a fellow pro-Second Amendment patriot and a friend – and I know I can count on you to at least consider giving this much if you can.

If you can’t, I understand.

**[I do hope you’ll at least consider giving $50 or $35 if what I asked for previously is just too much](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=1909wtz6bg247gn5mc09p7spsbthdk8m5f3ym4r1vv2s90rq4i73tk5m8hsc19yh3wvubh2glhn79w5jg61zza5uhb9mgsnd7u5lopc07q3scuk4jkv94wccb92ycr8tsaqq65gqn73vekffgh39iqbmbladaomdw053rkyrev2hiuxq4db5lazzivkj3j8ty6kd1i&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)**.

The United Nations is salivating at the thought of destroying our Second Amendment freedoms.

It’s up to you and me to stop them.

**[So please sign your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM and agree to your most generous contribution of $200, $100, $50, or at least $35 IMMEDIATELY](http://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=nw70oo21xva37w8vyc8o27huxaj4m1b5si9ckwoitiv344noq9mkhv886rvekncj9ze7jfubgwxtb2o6012ks16lte6no13xl3v2m3oxc537raol548qyhqegz3dg1ttupx24tr2a24ogknxr351c8swg6rku2dps95qbw3tzcslpahtlrub23vtq&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl3cvq&__onlt=h)**!

After all, they know guns in the hands of the “wrong” people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; ***ALL Treaty countries to allow firearms manufacturers to be sued for crimes committed with their products. Imagine how outrageous it would be if Ford was sued because an F-150 owner ran a red light and caused a crash! That’s what the gun grabbers want to do with firearms because they know this could END gun manufacturing; and ***That ALL countries involved in the export of firearms – including the United States – establish a “National Control System.” This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple – the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION. Now, Mexico is demanding that arms manufacturers provide them with full information on every gun sale! This case shows how serious they are about forcing the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on the United States – especially while they still have a puppet in the White House. The fact is, President Biden took an oath to “defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.” As the Defendants in this case stated in a recent court filing: “Mexico’s brazen attempt to regulate the American firearms industry based on its foreign interests poses a grave threat to the sovereignty of the United States, its citizens, and their Second Amendment rights.” But Joe Biden and Kamala Harris couldn’t care less – so long as it results in less freedom for you and me! While Mexico is blaming Smith & Wesson for “allowing” guns to fall into the hands of drug cartels, part of me wonders if it’s Biden’s ATF that’s truly to blame. You probably remember how, during the Obama Administration, the ATF launched Operation Fast and Furious, where they stood by silently, allowing guns sold in the U.S. to be illegally trafficked to Mexican gangs – until U.S. Border Patrol agent Brian Terry was killed with one of those guns. Would you put something like this past the Biden-Harris Administration? This is an administration who seems to want their legacy to be the complete and utter destruction of American freedom! They WILL get their way if I can’t count on your IMMEDIATE action. But I’m counting on you to make sure we’re heard. And the more signatures I can gather for this , the louder our message will be when tens of thousands of American gun owners have their names presented before the U.S. Supreme Court. Yes, Fellow Patriot, this case should be an open and shut one. After the Supreme Court’s 2022 Bruen decision, how could they possibly even think of siding with Mexico on this case? . Of course, in a perfect world, I wouldn’t have to ask you to do this... But that’s not the one we live in. After all, you’ve heard how judges rule on the law and never take into account public opinion. But how many Supreme Court decisions can you rattle off the top of your head where justices got it completely backward? The reason is that there are many judges who like to stick their fingers in the air to judge which way the political winds are blowing before they pick a side. Worse, they often make those decisions based on what they see in the media and the swamp elites they rub shoulders with... Fellow Patriot, it’s this bubble you and I have to break through. . But I hope you won’t stop there. Given the stakes in this battle, I hope you’ll consider giving generously as well. You see, to make the biggest and LOUDEST possible impact at the Supreme Court, I need to alert Second Amendment supporters across the country to this threat. Needless to say, that won’t be cheap. But we have no choice. The UN is NOT going to stop with destroying our Second Amendment freedoms, Fellow Patriot – as if that wasn’t bad enough. Disarming us is just the first step, so we’ll be powerless to stop the rest of their schemes they plan to impose on us. You and I both know that. . . This may be far more than you’ve ever given. In fact, some members of my staff were concerned that asking you for that much might upset you. Fellow Patriot, I certainly don’t want to upset you. But I also know you’re a fellow pro-Second Amendment patriot and a friend – and I know I can count on you to at least consider giving this much if you can. If you can’t, I understand. . The United Nations is salivating at the thought of destroying our Second Amendment freedoms. It’s up to you and me to stop them. ! For Freedom, Dudley Brown President National Association for Gun Rights P.S. The country of Mexico – a signer of the United Nation’s “Small Arms Treaty” -- is suing Smith & Wesson for supposedly “allowing” the guns they’ve built to be trafficked into the hands of Mexican criminals... And now the United States Supreme Court has agreed to step in and hear this case! .
