subject: What do you think about the campus protests?
body:
Have you followed the latest coming from college and university campuses in America?

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqk449jpvus0tskt98rokalr1jlck1r1lecu9t30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ieap74cdh2bs)
---
| | Have you followed the latest coming from college and university campuses in America?

In 2024, revolutionary leftists and rent-a-mob organizations funded by progressive billionaires occupied elite universities across the country.

Many of these universities canceled classes and commencement due to pro-terror protests. Police have arrested students and even professors at several institutions due to violence!

That's why I need to hear from you right away. What do you think about all of this?
**Could you please take a few minutes to complete our National Survey on Higher Education and let me know your thoughts[today](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjafsqtm050ufimljjf0amc6bmha5tdv0rielmmo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ieap74cdh2bs)?**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2cfmm4s5cf40l1n2v823aj36818cnohv0pmqvfg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ieap74cdh2bs)

It's no secret that these campus radicals get their inspiration from the student protestors of 1968...

Our country has changed a lot since that year. And I would say--and I think you agree--not for the better.

A big reason is that many of these radicals took over our education system...as professors, administrators, and government bureaucrats.

And they spread far-Left propaganda in our schools and culture with the help of big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars.

**Hillsdale College is one of the _only_ colleges in this country that hasn't fallen into this madness. **

We are one of the _only_ colleges that teach young Americans--and millions of people around this country--what makes our country the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

**But in response to the violent mobs we see in far too many colleges and universities, we need YOUR HELP to do even more. We must reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty, far beyond Hillsdale 's campus. **

We refuse to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly, in the form of federal or state student grants and loans.

This independence frees us from burdensome and corrupting regulations. It's why our college is a place that seeks to DEFEND LIBERTY rather than OVERTHROW IT.

But it comes at a cost! We rely heavily on the generosity of friends like you to do our work.

So, would you consider chipping in to help us **reach** and **teach** millions more citizens nationwide?

**You can teach millions** --everyone from the high school senior who takes a civics course in one of our K-12 classical schools using our **free** curriculum ...

...to the family who reads _Imprimis_ --our **free** digest of liberty--and engages in a lively discussion at the dinner table over what Heather Mac Donald, Victor Davis Hanson, or Christopher Rufo had to say ...

...to the grandparents who watch our **free** online courses on the Constitution and American history and tell stories to their grandchildren about the great heroes of liberty.

When elite schools are doing everything they can to destroy this country, you can change this country for the better--one person, one family, one community at a time.

So, after you take our survey, please consider supporting us once again.

Any gift you can give from **$10** , **$25** , **$35** , or even **$50** , if you've been especially blessed this year, will help us relentlessly pursue our mission on behalf of liberty--especially when our higher education is in crisis. But we need your help right away.

I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on Higher Education** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z12sqlr1nevjaib4v5r447s5g7a4emhm396tp9mg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ieap74cdh2bs)

Thank you in advance for letting me know your thoughts.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars have helped far-Left activists, administrators, and bureaucrats take over elite colleges and universities. That's why you see these places erupt in protests--and even violent mobs--that have led to canceled classes and commencements, and even the arrests of students and professors.

That's why I'm asking you today to take Hillsdale College's **National Survey on Higher Education**. It'll only take a few minutes. You can find our survey at the secure link here:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs67ccdhv7072os9kh9mm0fi4ndhvu57rjtemuu8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ieap74cdh2bs)**

Thanks again!

body:
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
Peter --
My family means the world to me.
In my mom and my sisters, I see the American dream.
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
We started with next to nothing. No money. No connections. But we made it, because the American dream is still alive.
There’s no doubt that it’s become more difficult to pursue, though. After I left the Marines, I knew my service to our country wasn’t over. I’ve dedicated the last 20 years of my life to strengthening the American dream and delivering for people who need help.
But people like Kari Lake, like Donald Trump, they’re only out for themselves. They’ll attack anyone who doesn’t fall in line. They’ll stop at nothing in their pursuit of power and influence.
This November is our best shot at rejecting the politics of Kari Lake and Donald Trump. I’m ready to do whatever I can to get us across the finish line, to defend Arizona and everything we’ve accomplished. But I can’t do this alone.
Please, Peter. Arizona starts voting today. We’re going all out to reach voters before they submit their ballots, and I need your help.
[**Can you make a split donation of $5 between me and Bob Casey? This is one of the last chances we’re going to get to reach the undecided voters who are going to decide this election.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241009-1?refcode=em20241009-1&refcode2=4489_552475_A7giiq&akid=4489%2E552475%2EA7giiq)

body:
| | | _“For now...”_ If you know my husband, Tom, you’ve probably heard him say this phrase more than once. To Tom, these two simple words are a reminder that no matter how tough the situation may seem, it’s never final. Challenges may loom, but they’re just obstacles "for now"—and with trust, hard work, and perseverance, they can be overcome. Whether advocating for our community in the State Legislature, serving as a volunteer firefighter, or facing personal setbacks, the “for now...” mindset has always kept him moving forward, ready to tackle the next hurdle. **Right now, we are in one of those challenging and uncertain moments. ** **We a re now less than **__[_**30 days away from Election Day**_** _._**](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=1e85fbeb0acf4000aed9cff7b46df848&_e=4JdhVRkIFK-bX766J3EaleUIZ8lbLe__rDNgWljZSWHx-_V4Tfu-kkAWi-0VcOhkUt8gTxzav7qk4vN9BWIfXHdMTfYNf6La9S9icAlGoKLcYXbd5J2n0LpsGKor9CTYLfTLQgtcrlybDC2W3K5Umm32YIzgWPR9UuIDs3lVG6wWkxduoRB84pzp7puRPWv27tWWOfLfLvA-AM51qupqjCgM3maaZJvElzNfWt0pE0WbcN-xWXZZrrATDDZ5kRGveXjFQOm5IdC5aym_b5FOGF_PyHrFn9xDjBMVYbNoTQqdNXbV0U7Mwly0yuun4XpqVyA5Q7bkf6eLZU3BxYM2Duw0sZXJn3LGdF2O4P2IFu2MY28DccvrPHIqlQYy3z12J_clE41lBHgJENEU-Yelgg%3D%3D)**Tom’s radical opponent is firing off attack ads against us and our FINAL end-of-month deadline is fast approaching—**** _which I have been told we are not on track to hit currently._** **_**If you have been waiting on the perfect time to make an impact for Team Kean, or if you are considering making an additional contribution, this is the time to do it:_**[**https://secure.winred.com/tomkean/something-ive-never-shared**](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=1e85fbeb0acf4000aed9cff7b46df848&_e=4JdhVRkIFK-bX766J3EaleUIZ8lbLe__rDNgWljZSWHx-_V4Tfu-kkAWi-0VcOhkUt8gTxzav7qk4vN9BWIfXBVaTj5hEqadxiWX5szhZfTUosO7qR9qp1VO0rRcIjgZ7leuQWA-HqtF3m1xbnCLfN8CZ8ha9kdp7kz974mkUuBN25EA3P5UyP31pYqUsd8-ugdfh9uOq8XQ-9Sy5XA--nFdN5fsgjOgrBwIq5oRYebWjfP2JIV39z48XOtWMhp2)** ** The outcome of this race, as I am sure you have heard, could send our community and nation into two _vastly_ different directions. At times, it can feel overwhelming, but I remind myself of Tom’s saying, and that the tough moments are only “for now”—especially when you are surrounded by the kind of team and support system like the one we have. I know that together, we CAN hold the line, defend our House majority, and bring even more stability and prosperity to the great people of New Jersey's seventh district.

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation that provides firefighters and their communities the protection they need**
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**
* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**
* **Passed legislation to support mental health for school children**

| | Have you followed the latest coming from college and university campuses in America?

In 2024, revolutionary leftists and rent-a-mob organizations funded by progressive billionaires occupied elite universities across the country.

Many of these universities canceled classes and commencement due to pro-terror protests. Police have arrested students and even professors at several institutions due to violence!

That's why I need to hear from you right away. What do you think about all of this?
**Could you please take a few minutes to complete our National Survey on Higher Education and let me know your thoughts[today](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd65uk5ud5bo8ukuhl1h8uqqjgg2chgon7ecs66g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie6o74cth2bs)?**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2jr0keokc04nqqqfjbl54rp2qca2ehkpuihphr8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie6o74cth2bs)

It's no secret that these campus radicals get their inspiration from the student protestors of 1968...

Our country has changed a lot since that year. And I would say--and I think you agree--not for the better.

A big reason is that many of these radicals took over our education system...as professors, administrators, and government bureaucrats.

And they spread far-Left propaganda in our schools and culture with the help of big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars.

**Hillsdale College is one of the _only_ colleges in this country that hasn't fallen into this madness. **

We are one of the _only_ colleges that teach young Americans--and millions of people around this country--what makes our country the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

**But in response to the violent mobs we see in far too many colleges and universities, we need YOUR HELP to do even more. We must reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty, far beyond Hillsdale 's campus. **

We refuse to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly, in the form of federal or state student grants and loans.

This independence frees us from burdensome and corrupting regulations. It's why our college is a place that seeks to DEFEND LIBERTY rather than OVERTHROW IT.

But it comes at a cost! We rely heavily on the generosity of friends like you to do our work.

So, would you consider chipping in to help us **reach** and **teach** millions more citizens nationwide?

**You can teach millions** --everyone from the high school senior who takes a civics course in one of our K-12 classical schools using our **free** curriculum ...

...to the family who reads _Imprimis_ --our **free** digest of liberty--and engages in a lively discussion at the dinner table over what Heather Mac Donald, Victor Davis Hanson, or Christopher Rufo had to say ...

...to the grandparents who watch our **free** online courses on the Constitution and American history and tell stories to their grandchildren about the great heroes of liberty.

When elite schools are doing everything they can to destroy this country, you can change this country for the better--one person, one family, one community at a time.

So, after you take our survey, please consider supporting us once again.

Any gift you can give from **$10** , **$25** , **$35** , or even **$50** , if you've been especially blessed this year, will help us relentlessly pursue our mission on behalf of liberty--especially when our higher education is in crisis. But we need your help right away.

I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on Higher Education** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpnni80onob6dkloe4cv4qkgcb1pel3e19pgdvqg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie6o74cth2bs)

Thank you in advance for letting me know your thoughts.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars have helped far-Left activists, administrators, and bureaucrats take over elite colleges and universities. That's why you see these places erupt in protests--and even violent mobs--that have led to canceled classes and commencements, and even the arrests of students and professors.

That's why I'm asking you today to take Hillsdale College's **National Survey on Higher Education**. It'll only take a few minutes. You can find our survey at the secure link here:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjnvodpvkcf2vuiq89m1jsgignr4k6urnmvrjna0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie6o74cth2bs)**

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94618068/504093650/664783965?ms=100924_Harris_Care&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDVlYTQzYS00OTg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1PUUA5v64nc44gsKK6U0-IAlluioCYTMof_58fkWG30=&emci=16e6c04c-ba85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=005ea43a-4986-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,
Yesterday, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a new proposal that would be life-changing for families and care workers across the country.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94618069/504093658/-461611900?ms=100924_Harris_Care&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDVlYTQzYS00OTg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1PUUA5v64nc44gsKK6U0-IAlluioCYTMof_58fkWG30=&emci=16e6c04c-ba85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=005ea43a-4986-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)
**This new proposal would allow Medicare to cover in-home healthcare** , relieving the financial strain of care on working families and allowing Americans who need around-the-clock or long-term care to receive these services within the warmth of their own homes.
Kamala Harris and Tim Walz represent the most pro-care presidential ticket in American history. We would know — we make electing care champions our priority, because #CareCantWait!
[**We need your help to ensure that this proposal becomes a reality. Sign up to volunteer with us today to elect Care Champions like Kamala Harris:**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94618070/504093679/-461611900?ms=100924_Harris_Care&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMDVlYTQzYS00OTg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1PUUA5v64nc44gsKK6U0-IAlluioCYTMof_58fkWG30=&emci=16e6c04c-ba85-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=005ea43a-4986-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=864787)

Our communities need legislation passed that supports Americans sandwiched between caring for older family members and young children. Vice President Kamala Harris has proved to us time and again that she will be the Care Champion for care workers and families, delivering for the sandwich generation.
Not only will this policy allow Americans who need care to remain in their homes, **improving the quality of life** for seniors and Americans with disabilities, but care workers will benefit from **an increase in jobs, and a substantial boost in federal support. **
Peter, we need all the help we can get to ensure this critical and life‐changing bill is passed. clean_body: Yesterday, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a new proposal that would be life-changing for families and care workers across the country. Hi Peter, Yesterday, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a new proposal that would be life-changing for families and care workers across the country. This new proposal would allow Medicare to cover in-home healthcare , relieving the financial strain of care on working families and allowing Americans who need around-the-clock or long-term care to receive these services within the warmth of their own homes. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz represent the most pro-care presidential ticket in American history. We would know — we make electing care champions our priority, because #CareCantWait! Our communities need legislation passed that supports Americans sandwiched between caring for older family members and young children. Vice President Kamala Harris has proved to us time and again that she will be the Care Champion for care workers and families, delivering for the sandwich generation. Not only will this policy allow Americans who need care to remain in their homes, improving the quality of life for seniors and Americans with disabilities, but care workers will benefit from an increase in jobs, and a substantial boost in federal support. Peter, we need all the help we can get to ensure this critical and life‐changing bill is passed. In solidarity, Hillary Holley Executive Director | Care in Action

body:

---

| | | | |
# Kamala & Patti:
# Defenders of Women’s Rights
---
| Peter,

**Women’s rights are on the line in this election.** From protecting access to healthcare to securing equal pay, our future depends on who we send to Washington. **Patti Hewitt and Kamala Harris are the leaders we need to stand up for women and fight for justice.

** Your vote is a vote for protecting reproductive rights, healthcare access, and equal opportunities for women across Georgia and the nation. **Together, we can elect champions who will defend these rights.**
* 🗳 **Voter Info:** Absentee voting is now open! You can apply to vote by mail until **October 25, 2024**. Don’t wait—request your absentee ballot today and be part of this historic moment. [**Apply here**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=eec0aacfa5&e=0f456155ff).

body:
Have you followed the latest coming from college and university campuses in America?

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zaokd889tc4oi9ba8qtker2u8lfc1oesc44cr4e0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie1or4clh2bs)

| | Have you followed the latest coming from college and university campuses in America?

In 2024, revolutionary leftists and rent-a-mob organizations funded by progressive billionaires occupied elite universities across the country.

Many of these universities canceled classes and commencement due to pro-terror protests. Police have arrested students and even professors at several institutions due to violence!

That's why I need to hear from you right away. What do you think about all of this?
**Could you please take a few minutes to complete our National Survey on Higher Education and let me know your thoughts[today](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpvot55en7uvuqps9ijp05h2cilmi2ilm6oecr90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie1or4clh2bs)?**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zct85ei41r5snc8flqpcsggfkrjk0hj57gdsfpno_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s5ie1or4clh2bs)

It's no secret that these campus radicals get their inspiration from the student protestors of 1968...

Our country has changed a lot since that year. And I would say--and I think you agree--not for the better.

A big reason is that many of these radicals took over our education system...as professors, administrators, and government bureaucrats.

And they spread far-Left propaganda in our schools and culture with the help of big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars.

**Hillsdale College is one of the _only_ colleges in this country that hasn't fallen into this madness. **

We are one of the _only_ colleges that teach young Americans--and millions of people around this country--what makes our country the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

**But in response to the violent mobs we see in far too many colleges and universities, we need YOUR HELP to do even more. We must reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty, far beyond Hillsdale 's campus. **

We refuse to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly, in the form of federal or state student grants and loans.

This independence frees us from burdensome and corrupting regulations. It's why our college is a place that seeks to DEFEND LIBERTY rather than OVERTHROW IT.

But it comes at a cost! We rely heavily on the generosity of friends like you to do our work.

So, would you consider chipping in to help us **reach** and **teach** millions more citizens nationwide?

Last Night, I went to support some local candidates State Senator Ryan Fazio and State Rep Candidate Tina Courpas at the Round Hill Community Center.
One of the largest subjects at last night's debate and one that we encounter were Traffic and Electric Rates. Traffic on I-95 and the needed Metro North upgrades are mainly federally funded (about 80 percent) and there needs to be a stronger partnership between state and federal government which has been ignored by Jim Himes since he took office.

* As you sit in traffic (during the normal work week), Blame Jim Himes.
* When you run a business and have to travel between clients and customers and have add an extra hour for leeway - Blame Jim Himes.
* When you are late to tuck you children in bed at night because of traffic - Blame Jim Himes
* **Jim is responsible for federal funding in this corridor and all federal funds run to Hartford and interchanges that do not help the economic engine of this state - Fairfield County.**

This speech I recently gave above sums up Jim - **No improvements for I-95 in 16 Years.**
Simple short-term solutions like moveable barriers will help especially in Stamford and Norwalk and longer exit ramps so that 3 lanes do not go to 2 just for those trying to get off the roads.
**I will let the video speak today. But if you are stuck in traffic - Blame Jim Himes**
Vote for me on November 5th with Early Voting October 21 - November 3 and I will work to improve I-95 and Metro North and help lower electric bills.
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support.

body:
President Trump and I are BOTH locked in a virtual tie in the polls, and he’s coming back to the commonwealth today for TWO back-to-back rallies in Scranton and Reading.
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=792702a8796140dea7aca3dc4ba50ac5&_e=ZblSqiSGdGap0HPxrZADa3evm8bMBqd4xKEJg4q-KNe-SZfZp9uC39dieoqIh0tTGXUb0Bfcb1CWm-ECuvMLSb0gUH3ar9CgktI4A3X90ZMnUB1hmEi3D8Y_BtKCXFVHAUwH40EMFt5jQBe4zReW86py4t5ga1iZ3LMiyL6YYbrEmUoxD7N765mTirUruSNgnsZSpKxHsHxv644112Z01-Vukgvmn-zzwRu6wMtAyHHLEVBJsA-KnF5yIj8VV7EeTQc1Bd1eR4xQ48UXB6HubEYFCIqOoqT3f-xWElCB5ldFOUIYROTvWr3U30BFfuHT5AoeLMayC_SFLTcAircor_vcJZfQa-hoXCUToJiGKLw2AcOR9P4pt7qa2qHFvjkvYYYzaBsjnzxJZhDRXTNscg%3D%3D)

Peter,

**Last week I stood with President Trump during his heroic return to Butler, PA.** I was sitting front row in July when we were only an inch away from losing him to an assassin's bullet.

President Trump and I are BOTH locked in a virtual tie in the polls, and he's coming back to the commonwealth today for TWO back-to-back rallies in Scranton and Reading.

**The Democrats have poured record amounts of money into winning Pennsylvania, and some are estimating total political spending in PA alone will top $1 BILLION.** **[You may have seen the numbers where Democrats are outraising the GOP, so before the day is over, I've set a goal of raising $55,000. Will you please split a donation between President Trump and me before the day is over?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=792702a8796140dea7aca3dc4ba50ac5&_e=ZblSqiSGdGap0HPxrZADa3evm8bMBqd4xKEJg4q-KNe-SZfZp9uC39dieoqIh0tTGXUb0Bfcb1CWm-ECuvMLSb0gUH3ar9CgktI4A3X90ZMnUB1hmEi3D8Y_BtKCXFVHAUwH40EMFt5jQBe4zReW86py4t5ga1iZ3LMiyL6YYbrEmUoxD7N765mTirUruSNgnsZSpKxHsHxv644112Z01-Vukgvmn-zzwRu6wMtAyHHLEVBJsA-KnF5yIj8VV7EeM-vHVY1BApNdUHqpGVRdTFoH-jSUHGcG76K4DRDjEfjS0rNOIeZlsbQZGeLYFYp6Af5rkycRg4NlvW3vmLZKBS-qQAUUZvHHi307gVajVjY0kOkpdJjIYsPKxPnH_qzJSLMaf5fz7Qi7A8Zf_K04vw%3D%3D)**

[DONATE](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=792702a8796140dea7aca3dc4ba50ac5&_e=ZblSqiSGdGap0HPxrZADa3evm8bMBqd4xKEJg4q-KNe-SZfZp9uC39dieoqIh0tTGXUb0Bfcb1CWm-ECuvMLSb0gUH3ar9CgktI4A3X90ZMnUB1hmEi3D8Y_BtKCXFVHAUwH40EMFt5jQBe4zReW86py4t5ga1iZ3LMiyL6YYbrEmUoxD7N765mTirUruSNgnsZSpKxHsHxv644112Z01-Vukgvmn-zzwRu6wMtAyHHLEVBJsA-KnF5yIj8VV7EeNFbhfVQXcKBPao6LNbe9YFW6LIaol1hoLd9FIZqKk2gbyFV_DJzEsALs89Z9jY1TnRkpx3ZzcdJvr0HAQzqBh6udghpc8fuFZsTl5K2lu5Hrp248Zj7mfnbrCL2QDfeFjPTqlRYTsC2WPU7twOyl6A%3D%3D)
---

Reaching this goal is so important because voting is already under way, we're committed to winning, and we have less than FOUR weeks until the final votes are cast.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=792702a8796140dea7aca3dc4ba50ac5&_e=ZblSqiSGdGap0HPxrZADa3evm8bMBqd4xKEJg4q-KNe-SZfZp9uC39dieoqIh0tTGXUb0Bfcb1CWm-ECuvMLSb0gUH3ar9CgktI4A3X90ZMnUB1hmEi3D8Y_BtKCXFVHAUwH40EMFt5jQBe4zReW86py4t5ga1iZ3LMiyL6YYbrEmUoxD7N765mTirUruSNgnsZSpKxHsHxv644112Z01-Vukgvmn-zzwRu6wMtAyHHLEVBJsA-KnF5yIj8VV7Eexqa_80v_C9pSNdWUajyeOoqEMF567Nl5Jk48ls5cKlTWTMlI5YiyZh725eIez5YWRzdfJJ3R3RkYPr_5tzSC8s1SAv17E0cb_pIyTNmFKm1Ypn3xUZIA1QP6NC0JYFXTnrsHY0cGPDh1uwUSg3YN8g%3D%3D)

After President Trump was shot in Butler, he rose brilliantly to the occasion. I've said this before, but as a combat veteran, I learned that you can't predict how someone will respond under fire until it happens. In what will be an iconic image for the ages, he raised his fist in defiance, reassuring our country, and showed true grace amid a lethal attack.

He demonstrated the strength and resolve that the leader of the free world simply must have. We must continue to FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT for our country!

**But in order to win, it will take all of us standing together and fighting together every day of this race.**

With all eyes on Pennsylvania and our state being a MUST-WIN state to flip the White House and Senate majority, anything you can give today will go a long way.

What we're able to raise today plays a key part in what we're able to spend in these final weeks. We have to give it all we've got. **[So please, chip in whatever you can to split between President Trump and me today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=792702a8796140dea7aca3dc4ba50ac5&_e=ZblSqiSGdGap0HPxrZADa3evm8bMBqd4xKEJg4q-KNe-SZfZp9uC39dieoqIh0tTGXUb0Bfcb1CWm-ECuvMLSb0gUH3ar9CgktI4A3X90ZMnUB1hmEi3D8Y_BtKCXFVHAUwH40EMFt5jQBe4zReW86py4t5ga1iZ3LMiyL6YYbrEmUoxD7N765mTirUruSNgnsZSpKxHsHxv644112Z01-Vukgvmn-zzwRu6wMtAyHHLEVBJsA-KnF5yIj8VV7Ee5Sa0P6q9qKqeLtw93xCMf-gfpRnUc9Gd2Zl32vJwooIZgOyT6LBUc0NgmFrw_d6bEo9SFgi_CFX2_Ev_hVnsecu4HHIHNWmA8vAiyCqfBP0CLeoGJUn3FOepk3Luq4tUr5wg3iTAfAm4_zNTE0VYtQ%3D%3D)**

Dave McCormick

Nothing is ever good enough for opponents of voting rights.
If the ballots are counted quickly and efficiently, reporting the results in a timely manner? " Oh it's rigged, no way they could have gone that fast ."
If precincts take their time counting the ballots and report everything at once? " Oh look how it all came in together, it's totally rigged ."
If the count takes a while, with precincts checking and reporting things all along the way? " Oh that took way too long, they were 'finding' more votes for themselves, that's completely rigged. "
These vote suppressors hold no logical position because they want you scared of voting and scared of our democracy. They think the only legitimate elections are the ones they win . And even then, opponents of voting rights will protest their own election race even if other races go the way they want for their party.

Our elections are closely monitored. Electronic vote counting is backed up by human tabulation. Nonpartisan election workers monitor everything, and in many states, partisan activists are there to question and verify results as well.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=89ac56b46c36472582094cf7d9869615&_e=g_vaavzCDgID8X9ZYwEJ2lyejFPNc9uV2uIsRhUDmbmWcinddtcDrKZDMQnaX4SogPYQXp80s36LqqlV8aqwG51kWLiYg5wG4--uD2ndOY06x0LlFjQZerDa7e5TOH7jTXA9G_qRX3yripSBA6mJtfescQzneJPsJ7dlMGDwsyXAFlW4YYwBbvC-4O_hh-Ccq0dOmJz5WBnoNVW4OnK1HxxXzFUq7wx_FZAfckkiAKOoFIQ3_oILOhq58kwQGeagteJy_vrxH-Gg93GNpQki8tzPLcO6mQxBw-T4YqJCysRv66U8ymJ16-0tREPQIkJoDNuH6s5N8A9k-c_JT8hzhDgDiWDD1kzpB37SfAoJHWg8Lnj1tE9qtBOCJEK1WAn1bI7CtGIQCsGLHH8is2ShxA%3D%3D)

Peter,

**Last week I stood with President Trump during his heroic return to Butler, PA.** I was sitting front row in July when we were only an inch away from losing him to an assassin's bullet.

Hi folks,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we're just about a month away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.
And we need your help.
Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But our multimillionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.
We can’t write our campaigns million-dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: you. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers – you name it – who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.
We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.

## **RITE celebrates victory in NH Election Day registration case: Photo ID law will be in effect**

A pair of New Hampshire Supreme Court rulings mean that Voter ID will be required for people who register to vote on Election Day. The high court’s decision to stay the appeals until after election day means that efforts by two of the highest paid democratic operatives to subvert the will of the people and invalidate New Hampshire’s democratically enacted laws have failed.
Derek Lyons, President of Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections PAC (RITE PAC), a political association that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today issued the following statement:

“Despite the best efforts by some of the most well-funded Democrat lawyers in the country, who go from state to state on a mission to undermine election safeguards, common sense will prevail on Election Day 2024 in New Hampshire. Large bipartisan majorities in both the country and New Hampshire support requiring people who seek to register to vote on election day to produce photographic identification to confirm their identities. New Hampshire’s requirement that individuals do just that reinforces the public’s trust and faith in the electoral process. RITE PAC is grateful for the court’s ruling and pleased to have played a role in this important victory for the people of New Hampshire.”

clean_body: Those registering to vote on Election Day without ID will have to provide documents within 7 days | | | | | RITE celebrates victory in NH Election Day registration case: Photo ID law will be in effect A pair of New Hampshire Supreme Court rulings mean that Voter ID will be required for people who register to vote on Election Day. The high court’s decision to stay the appeals until after election day means that efforts by two of the highest paid democratic operatives to subvert the will of the people and invalidate New Hampshire’s democratically enacted laws have failed. Derek Lyons, President of Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections PAC (RITE PAC), a political association that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today issued the following statement: “Despite the best efforts by some of the most well-funded Democrat lawyers in the country, who go from state to state on a mission to undermine election safeguards, common sense will prevail on Election Day 2024 in New Hampshire. Large bipartisan majorities in both the country and New Hampshire support requiring people who seek to register to vote on election day to produce photographic identification to confirm their identities. New Hampshire’s requirement that individuals do just that reinforces the public’s trust and faith in the electoral process. RITE PAC is grateful for the court’s ruling and pleased to have played a role in this important victory for the people of New Hampshire.” | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2024 Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections, All rights reserved.

In 2011, in the blink of an eye, my life changed forever: I was shot in the head while holding an event with constituents in a grocery store parking lot. Six people were killed that day, and 12 others were injured. For me, moving forward from this tragedy meant going back to my roots: public service and making life better for my community. And in this year’s election, democracy, safety, and a better future for our kids and our community are on the line. [_**That’s why I’m proud to endorse Kristen McDonald Rivet in the race for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94632976/504134609/2004511195?refcode=email_100924_Giffords&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjE3OTgwYS01YTg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w3OYJZ_tY0WlDG62JyqHlmEiASjvg49Y_7Wqnrwq2Tk=) Kristen has fought to keep communities safe and delivered real results to prevent gun violence in Michigan — and she is a leader we can count on to keep doing it. Kristen has made the state safer by fighting to close dangerous ghost gun loopholes and holding accountable those who illegally traffic guns. Michigan needs a champion like Kristen in Congress. Kristen realizes the heartbreak gun violence causes in his state, and will never stop working to end it. Her leadership will be critical for our next victories in Congress to prevent future tragedies. GIFFORDS PAC is proud to endorse Kristen, who has the courage to fight to end gun violence. Kristen has always focused on making Michigan communities safer. In Congress, Kristen will keep taking on the big fights to protect Michigan and save lives. Last night, we held a critical prayer call with pastors in areas affected by Hurricane Helene, as well as pastors in the path of Hurricane Milton. Over 120,000 joined online last night, and we want to extend the opportunity to share the call with those who missed the livestream. We gathered to pray for both the Lord's favor in the recovery efforts already underway, and for His protection for the people of Florida.

We also talked about what is being done as we mobilize our relief operation and head to North Carolina! Watch the prayer call below and check the bottom of the email to see what supplies we are working to collect to bless those impacted by Hurricane Helene.

Let me tell you why you should care...
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241009&akid=1284%2E587540%2EKOXOsN - Split LWD-Harris&t=1)
Peter, Kamala Harris went on Call Her Daddy – a podcast series hosted by Alex Cooper. Let me tell you why you should care...
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241009?refcode=em20241009&amount=5&refcode2=1284_587540_KOXOsN&akid=1284%2E587540%2EKOXOsN)
The topline? **Kamala Harris is reaching out to young people in this country with her arms wide open.**
Call Her Daddy is the second-most popular podcast in the world with over 5 million downloads each week. The “Daddy Gang” – a term to describe the Call Her Daddy audience – is made up of mostly women between the ages of 18 and 24.
Kamala Harris went on to speak about women’s rights and her thoughts on the largest issues facing women in the upcoming election. It’s an understatement to say that abortion rights and accessible reproductive care are huge issues on the minds of folks heading into Election Day.
Call Her Daddy is not a political show – the audience is made up of a wide cross section of women with various political views, and many of them are not engaged at all with politics or maybe feeling a little frustrated with politics now.
By appearing on Alex Cooper’s podcast, Kamala is talking to an audience that may not have been listening before – but will be affected adversely by another Trump presidency – about Democrats’ pro-choice, pro-freedom agenda.
**Leaders We Deserve applauds Kamala Harris for reaching out to young people. We believe that the future of our country rests in the hands of young people – some of whom will be casting ballots for the first time ever in this historic election.**
And these young voters deserve candidates like Kamala Harris – and the 13 young progressives we’ve endorsed in critical races across the country – who will meet them where they are and take real action on the issues that impact them most.

subject: RITE Puts Virginia on Alert for Voter Registration Act Violations
body:
Virginia election officials are violating federal law by withholding critical information |
---
| |
---
| |
## **RITE Puts Virginia on Alert for Voter Registration Act Violations**
Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), in support of nonprofit Electoral Process Education Corporation (“EPEC”), [has notified Virginia election officials](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4e23f85065&e=ea91f782ea) they are violating federal law by withholding information critical to efforts to verify the accuracy of the Commonwealth’s voter rolls.

Virginia is violating the National Voter Registration Act (“NVRA”) and a 2012 court order by withholding full birthdates from datasets the law requires ELECT to provide to nonprofit and political organizations. The state abruptly announced its decision to withhold this information just weeks before the 2024 General Election, just when groups like EPEC need it most to verify the accuracy and currency of Virginia’s voter registration list.

EPEC has used birthdates to identify noncitizens on the registration list, to identify duplicate records, and to identify persons registered in multiple states. Virginia’s unlawful decision severely impairs EPEC’s ability to successfully continue this important work.

RITE President and CEO Derek Lyons issued the following statement:

“Virginia must reverse course and comply with federal law, which requires it to produce full birthdates of every person registered to vote in the Commonwealth to groups like EPEC that request it. In fact, in 2012, a court ordered Virginia to do just that so organizations can better evaluate the accuracy of the state’s voter registration records. Virginia’s sudden policy change is part of a troubling trend of states trying to impair the ability of organizations to assess the currency and accuracy of their voter rolls. Courts have consistently blocked these unlawful attacks on transparency, and we are confident they will do so again here if Virginia does not quickly course correct.”
###

subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your National
Survey on the United States Supreme Court using this secure link:

attention-and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

### The role of climate change in making superstorms and my own experiences in Katrina and Florida.
| Oct 9
---|---
---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=283449&post_id=150011951&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUwMDExOTUxLCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTcyODQ5MTg5MSwiZXhwIjoxNzMxMDgzODkxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjgzNDQ5Iiwic3ViIjoicmVhY3Rpb24ifQ.WOFFs7QOEnhz7OCgiTMNKkBCxo_Kqtbk-BsTsZmxZOY&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/rebekahjones/p/hurricane-milton-is-a-climate-crisis?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1a73fab0-5717-4a5d-ab4e-bec56ebd15d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Satellite view of Hurricane Milton from NOAA/NESDIS/STAR, taken October 7, 2024
I was 16 years old when the eye of Hurricane Katrina passed by my hometown in coastal Mississippi. The center of her eyewall was 27.82 miles west of my home. The eye at that point -- on August 29, 2005 -- was about 25 miles wide, putting me and my family in the worst possible location for the worst of the storm's impacts.
Hurricane Katrina was a rare beast -- its[ double eyewall](https://substack.com/redirect/5c3bc587-b9e0-41bf-b102-611c79c64aca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), record-shattering storm surge, intense low pressure, and the bathymetry of where it hit made it a once-in-a-lifetime storm.
That one storm erased hundreds of years of history along the Mississippi and Louisiana Gulf Coasts. It demonstrated the best and the worst of our institutions -- the government, media, and NGO's.
It reshaped my understanding of the world, and inspired me to seek out answers about how these "perfect storms" form and devastate communities.
Today, [after a four-year detour](https://substack.com/redirect/7115b641-db69-449f-b873-4580b85c309d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I'm a climate specialist for the federal government working directly with at-risk communities to prepare for storms in a warmed world.
And I want to make clear to all my readers where the facts stand on climate change and hurricanes, so that you, too, can better inform others.
Because Hurricane Milton is a climate-crisis fueled storm.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sMm9DNl05qXUhxbuXG6dK1t-rXccvGMrUseRq0hX1yk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150011951)
#### **Forward speed**
Hurricanes are [moving slower ](https://substack.com/redirect/3f8e1310-854f-4db9-bd8b-54ad24f60fdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and [stalling](https://substack.com/redirect/b7bf1621-12a3-496c-9b1f-8e7abafa9640?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near shorelines. The slower the rate that storms move across the [abnormally warm ocean basins](https://substack.com/redirect/c10f0f5a-beff-4b8f-88ad-bed2945e5af2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the bigger and stronger they can become. The slower they move over land, the more rainfall and damage they inflict. Forward speed has decreased by 17% in the Atlantic basin since 1900 ([IPCC, Page 1587](https://substack.com/redirect/3f8e1310-854f-4db9-bd8b-54ad24f60fdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
#### **Rapid Intensification**
Higher sea surface temperatures and lower salinity increase the amount of moisture available to storms, fueling [rapid intensification](https://substack.com/redirect/180f609e-1ee4-4029-ae21-342f7cfe4bfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But major bursts of thunderstorms far from the storm's center can[ also fuel this process](https://substack.com/redirect/9241130a-f7b8-4605-9029-c2db18010cd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even if overall conditions don't favor rapid development.
Hurricane Milton rapidly intensified from a Category 1 to Category 5 hurricane in 24 hours, [making it the third-fastest acceleration in history](https://substack.com/redirect/7ba810fe-5506-4ad6-b825-4dec33983e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), behind only 2005's Wilma (the strongest hurricane ever recorded) and Felix (2007) in terms of rapid intensification.
#### **Rainfall**
Scientists [have already observed ](https://substack.com/redirect/0c932c05-28ec-4f57-9e7a-1c76630209cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)significant increases in rainfall from hurricanes over the last century. Hurricane Helene, which hit Florida before inundating Appalachia just a few weeks ago, formed in the Gulf of Mexico above record-hot sea surface temperatures (SSTs). Climate change caused a [40-70%](https://substack.com/redirect/e5c2e30d-39f7-4fb1-961f-9954ea5f6ef2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) increase in rainfall during Hurricane Helene, and has caused a 10-15% increase in rainfall associated with tropical cyclones overall.
#### **Wind speeds**
Hurricane windspeeds are, on average, 11% more intense because of global warming. More [major hurricane events](https://substack.com/redirect/1dac9214-73c0-4f98-8d62-9ff2791cb0ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are occurring compared to prior centuries, as well.
#### Mean Latitude and Seasonality
One of the clearest and direct impacts of global warming on tropical cyclones is the poleward shift of peak intensity for tropical cyclones. That means as warm waters expand the tropics, tropical storms are migrating northward, too. [See my video about Hurricane Kirk here.](https://substack.com/redirect/bd5e405f-79a5-4a7f-ad34-0382c714fa30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With waters generally warmer throughout the year, more hurricanes are appearing outside of historical peak months, extending the season.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/187440af-7dbe-4df1-8a63-6375838c3067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Map of tropical cyclone changes from the IPCC AR6
#### **Minimum Pressure, Storm Surge**
While we classify hurricanes based solely on maximum sustained winds, minimum central pressure better fits models and observations of total storm damage. And although central pressure and wind speed are closely related,[ they are not identical](https://substack.com/redirect/5fdd9e11-1e58-4fb7-aa6e-11130d0259ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and central pressure is [widely regarded as the more reliable measure of storm strength.](https://substack.com/redirect/2f5f7e47-be5f-4a4f-a5b4-facf509e81dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Research from LSU shows that minimum central pressure 48-72 hours before landfall is the best measure for estimating storm surge. Hurricane Katrina (2005), for example, set the record for hurricane storm surge at 28 feet in south Mississippi. While wind speeds at landfall were measured at Category 3 strength1, the storm's minimum pressure bottomed out at 902 mbar -- making it third strongest hurricane by central pressure to ever make landfall in the United States (behind only 1969s's Camille and the 1935 Labor Day Storm).
Milton became the fifth-strongest Atlantic Basin hurricane on record Monday, October 7, 2024, reaching a minimum pressure of 897 millibars -- about 54 hours before expected landfall. While surge is driven by a multitude of factors, including track, bathymetry, forward speed, etc., this does not bode well from an area of Florida that's [previous peak storm ](https://substack.com/redirect/19f93f71-cc21-4d25-b2b2-b52e45ed5269?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)tide2 was 10 feet back in 1921. Worse still, Milton will make landfall [during high-tide](https://substack.com/redirect/37a355e8-49d1-40d4-be0c-639bf9eea448?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), adding 2.4 feet of water to the[ total storm tide level.](https://substack.com/redirect/1efbc2d2-d312-45c3-88ee-01495169d616?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The previous record storm surge for the Tampa area -- 7.8 ft -- was[ broken two weeks ago when Helene struck Florida](https://substack.com/redirect/1efbc2d2-d312-45c3-88ee-01495169d616?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
#### **Sea level rise.**
Global sea levels[ have risen about 9 inches since 1880, and 4 inches just since 1993, ](https://substack.com/redirect/a92c43a8-3eb5-4e87-a9c3-038f94083c4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and are[ expected to rise up to 10 feet mor](https://substack.com/redirect/1bd205fc-0d6c-45a2-ac64-d2b115df3e7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)e by the end of the century. In the Tampa Bay area, [sea levels are rising at a faster rate](https://substack.com/redirect/f6d09493-3bd8-4e37-8ca1-1716c9c14590?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (5.8 mm/yr) than the global average (3.4 mm/yr).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aba7c82e-9f8a-4f4f-9c15-f725742237fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Peter, Next month, a new 13,000-square-foot recovery housing facility will open in Portland. The facility will be able to serve 40 Oregonians at a time, providing a supportive place to be after leaving residential treatment for substance abuse, and offering a bridge to an independent, stable life. This kind of support and intentional community is an important part of Oregon’s continuum of care to address our state’s addiction crisis. **This is the exact kind of effort we need to see more of across Oregon. ** Recovery housing is one critical resource for helping folks have the time and support they need for a healthier life. And we have more to do! subject: Crippling
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Arizona simply does not have blowout elections, and Kari Lake lost her last race by less than 1% of all votes cast. If we’re going to defeat her this time we need to hit these goals.
_* Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
Peter, we’re sorry to bother you.
We’re sure you’ve got better things to do.
But Ruben Gallego’s fundraising is running into an absolutely crippling slowdown right now.
We set a 50,000 donation goal ahead of Wednesday, October 9th. That’s an important date for three reasons:
1. It is the day that Ruben is going to debate Kari Lake.
2. It is the day that early voting begins in Arizona.
3. It is the day that mail-in ballots start getting sent out to voters.

We won’t beat around the bush — we’re way behind on that goal. So far behind that we’re not sure how we’ll get there.
But the reality here is that this race is far closer than the polls show. Arizona simply does not have blowout elections, and Kari Lake lost her last race by less than 1% of all votes cast. If we’re going to defeat her this time we need to hit these goals.
That’s the only way we’ll fund a campaign that can win. That’s the truth.

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12710599?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

Another hurricane is heading Florida’s way, and I want to encourage the district to stay informed and take the necessary steps to be prepared. Hurricane Milton has strengthened into a major storm and is projected to make landfall this evening. As Marion County is under a Hurricane Warning, please [sign up for AlertMarion](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0e3d74d172&e=d1c1b9864f), an emergency alert and notification program that provides time-sensitive emergency alerts to residents.

For additional resources and updates on the storm, visit [Marion County’s Emergency Communications](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=941ffa69e8&e=d1c1b9864f) page. Please plan accordingly and stay safe. Ensure you have essential prep items like first aid kits, flashlights, bottled water, and nonperishable foods. See the disaster supply kit checklist found at [floridadisaster.org/planprepare/hurricane-supply-checklist/](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=97093b625f&e=d1c1b9864f). It is important that we take this storm seriously. Please stay safe, everyone!
---
| | **Inaugural Meeting of the Marion County Young Republicans Club**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I had the opportunity to attend and say a few words at the inaugural meeting of the Marion County Young Republicans Club. The founder of the club, Ellary Belote, was also elected as their President. I look forward to seeing the incredible things this group of like-minded individuals will accomplish going into the future.
---
| | **Hackin’ It for Hospice Charity Golf Tournament**
---
|
---
---
| It was an honor to attend and speak at the Hackin’ It for Hospice charity golf tournament. The fundraiser was a great success for the Nancy Renyhart Dementia Education Center. Under the leadership of Governor Ron DeSantis, the state has approved up to $500,000 in additional help towards these causes. Marion County continues to lead the way in making a difference for Florida’s future. Thank you to Dr. Renny Edelson and Damian Romano for hosting such a great event!
---
| | **Ocala/Marion County CEP President’s Luncheon**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of attending the Ocala/Marion County CEP President’s Luncheon. With Marion County being one of the largest growing counties in the United States, it is great to see so many entrepreneurial minds coming together for the betterment of our community. I look forward to continuing to watch our businesses boom here and all across Florida.
---
| | **AIF Political & Policy Retreat Chairman’s Dinner**
---
|
---
---
| It was wonderful to attend the AIF Political & Policy Retreat Chairman’s Dinner. With the keynote speaker being Representative Tom Leek, it was a great way to learn about the best pathway forward for policies that impact businesses, both large and small, throughout the State of Florida.
---
| | **Speaking with Students at Souls Harbor Christian Academy**
---
|
---
| I had the opportunity to speak with the high school class at Souls Harbor Christian Academy on all things Florida politics. I was extremely impressed with the questions these young people had and am inspired by the next generation.
---
| | **Watch My Podcast - The Constitutional Entrepreneur**
---
| [ ](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c18953bc39&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| You can watch my podcast, The Constitutional Entrepreneur, on [YouTube](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=1831068941&e=d1c1b9864f) by clicking above or by [listening on Apple Podcasts](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9b5b301555&e=d1c1b9864f).

I believe our country was founded on Godly, entrepreneurial principles. The more we deviate from those principles, the more political problems we seem to have. Let’s influence this generation to move back towards them. I’m excited to share what I’ve learned and am still learning. I’m also excited to introduce you to other key influencers and what they have learned. We’re in this together!
---
|
---
| | Thank you for reading, and I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Please stay safe!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

27 DAYS!
To Get Me in Washington–
Vote for Trump
Dear Peter,
27 days.
The stakes are sky-high.
This may be the most critical election of our lifetime.
[And I want to remind all my supporters that the only way to bring about the change we so desperately need is to _vote for Donald Trump_.](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_9_24_una1&n=5)
**Voting for Trump** isn’t just a vote for him; it’s a vote to restore free speech, end government overreach, and fight back against the forces trying to silence us.
So, wherever you live – red state, blue state, or swing state – it’s essential to vote Tump.
Let me make this real for you. Right now, free speech is under withering and relentless attack in America and across the globe. In a lot of countries, the state controls the media and censors the internet. Brazil just banned Twitter because Elon Musk refused to censor user speech.
Kamala Harris says Musk better behave himself or he will “lose his privileges.”
She thinks – and the Democratic establishment thinks – free speech is a privilege.
**__Well, I think it is a right_._**
And if Kamala Harris is elected, the powers behind her will quash that right. They are already halfway there. It will be too late by 2028.
**Once we are in the grips of totalitarianism, we won’t be able to vote our way out of it. This is our last chance to stop them.**
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_9_24_una1&n=6)
After long conversations with President Trump and his team, I know that he is fully convinced of this priority. He sees the censorship machine for what it is. Remember, he was kicked off Twitter back in 2021.
And he has experienced directly how government agencies are being weaponized to destroy political opponents.
[**He is going to be relying on me to help clean up that corruption, and that’s why I’m relying on my supporters to help him return to the White House.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_9_24_una1&n=7)
As you know, this could be a very close election. A disputed election result would be a disaster for our divided nation.
President Trump needs to win in a landslide both in the Electoral College and the popular vote. He can’t do it unless my supporters join him and look at the big picture.
**We have to unify** if we are to overthrow the entrenched elites who are ruining our country.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_9_24_una1&n=8)
[I am fully committed to this path, but in this last month, **I need your support to make the final push to reclaim America.** ](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_9_24_una1&n=9)

Jon Tester’s got to keep up the moderate facade he’s cultivated through his years in Washington – so the dirt farmer is farming out his dirty work to the biggest yapper on the left. An excerpt from the email I received from Carville on Tuesday morning read, “Tim Sheehy is an embarrassment. He’s willing to lie about every damn thing under the sun to win this race.” And that, “Jon Tester wiped the floor” with me. I can assure you that the only embarrassing thing that came out of Monday evening’s debate was that Jon Tester felt he had to enlist James Carville to attack me rather than do it himself. Here’s my message to the crass, out-of-touch political hack, James Carville:While I was serving our country honorably in Afghanistan, Jon Tester was being wined and dined by Washington, D.C. lobbyists in some of the city’s most fashionable restaurants. For everyday Americans, the choice couldn’t be more straightforward: support a former Navy SEAL who understands what’s at stake in an increasingly volatile world, a veteran who has taken on terrorists in hand-to-hand combat. Or reelect a career politician with a penchant for expensive steaks, Toyota Prius’, and $15 cranberry vodkas. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Republican Nominee for U.S. Senate - Montana | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. Use of his military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

name: Senate Conservatives
subject: Don’t Forget the Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SENATE CONSERVATIVES ACTION AND NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law | | |
---
You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**

Tony Vargas is a State Senator, public school teacher, and Dad running to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District and unseat Republican Don Bacon.

This fight is personal. The American Dream made Tony’s story possible. He refuses to sit on the sidelines while others struggle to achieve the same dream.

This fight is also high stakes. Joe Biden won the presidency because of Nebraska. Now, Tony’s fighting to finish what he started and flip this district blue. ## Lawsuit Filed to Stop the NextEra Battery Storage Facility!
| | |
---
|
### Another day, another lawsuit... **Part II**
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
Dear Neighbors,

The fight to stop the NextEra battery storage facility is ongoing, and we want to thank you for the incredible support you’ve shown. Your donations, advocacy, and determination have brought us to this critical point in our efforts to protect our community’s health and safety. We’re in this together.

We’re writing to share an important update: a lawsuit has been filed against the City of College Park over the approval of the NextEra battery storage facility. This legal action directly challenges the City Council’s failure to follow proper procedures and their disregard for our community’s concerns.
| | |
---
|
### We’re focused on three main points in the lawsuit:
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTM2MDM1MDIwLFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiY2E1NjVhNzI4ODg4ZjJlNCJ9) 1\. **Lack of Proper Notification:** From the very beginning, residents were not properly informed about the project. This includes inadequate signage with incorrect addresses and other critical details. The community never had a fair chance to participate in the process. 2\. **Violation of Due Process:** By placing NextEra-related items on the City Council’s agenda at the last minute without notice, the council denied residents their right to be heard. This lack of transparency is a direct violation of due process, which ensures that the community is given a fair and equal opportunity to voice concerns before decisions are made. 3\. **Failure to Follow Zoning Procedures:** The City failed to comply with its own zoning ordinance and Georgia state law, which sets clear guidelines on how rezoning hearings should be handled. These guidelines were ignored, making the entire process fundamentally flawed from the start.
|
---
|
# Review the Lawsuit
| | | | [ Click Here ](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTM5MTgwNzUxLFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiMDA1M2QyYTc2MTBiYTI5YSJ9)
---
| | |
---
|
### Here’s a quick recap of the timeline that brought us to this point:
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTQzMzc1MDU4LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiZTk3ZjU3Mzg1OTk5YTM2ZSJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTQ3NTY5MzY1LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiNjBkZGMxMjE3YWE2MDZlYyJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTUwNzE1MDk2LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiZDc3MTJhMTk3M2NmMjZhNiJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTU0OTA5NDAzLFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiOWJmN2M3YjBjNzA2NmE3ZiJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTU4MDU1MTM0LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiNjZiYzIzNTUxZDRmNGYwYyJ9) [](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTYxMjAwODY1LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiYjQ3OWFiOTk0MjI0OWZkYyJ9)
* **May 28, 2021** : NextEra Energy first applied to rezone 62 acres for the battery storage facility, marking the start of their push to build in our community.
* **August-September 2021** : Hearings were held, but the City Council deferred its decision after we raised concerns about inadequate notice and sign postings—an early victory for community voices.
* **October 18, 2021** : Despite ongoing issues with notification, the Council again considered the rezoning application, raising more concerns about transparency and proper procedure. When the rezoning was voted on, it was DEFEATED.
* **May 30, 2023** : NextEra resubmitted an identical application, showing their determination to move forward despite strong opposition from our community.
* **August 7, 2023** : Another hearing was held, and again, we voiced concerns about notification issues. While the rezoning motion failed, the Council’s actions raised serious questions about their commitment to transparency. When the rezoning was voted on, it was DEFEATED, again!.
* **March 18, 2024** : In a [move that blindsided many](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTY0MzQ2NTk2LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiZjkyYTk1ODgyZWEyZjcyMiJ9), the Council added two NextEra-related items to the agenda at the last minute—without notice. There was NO PUBLIC HEARING held. The "new" council then approved both the rezoning and a [$1.6 million](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTY4NTQwOTA0LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiY2ZhMzA3MTUzZDZjMjkwMSJ9) “economic grant” from NextEra.
* **September 16, 2024** : We sent a [demand letter to the City Attorney](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTcxNjg2NjM1LFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiMmE4MzQzNTcxYTE2NWUwZiJ9) outlining procedural defects and urging the City to reconsider.
* **September 23, 2024** : The City failed to respond by the deadline, forcing us to move forward with legal action.
* **October 4, 2024** : The [lawsuit was officially filed](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0NzM3NjU4OTc1ODgwOTQzLFwiclwiOjEzNDczNzY1OTQwMzcwMDA2M30iLCJzIjoiZDRhZjRiMTIwNTk5YzVkYyJ9), taking our fight beyond City Hall and into the courts.

| | |
---
|
### What's Next?
---
| | |
---
|
---
As you can see, the City’s handling of this issue has been flawed from the beginning. Their disregard for proper procedure and failure to listen to our concerns has left us no choice but to seek justice through the courts.

This lawsuit is a testament to the strength of our community. It shows what we can achieve when we stand together against a common threat. But the road ahead won’t be easy. This legal battle will take time, resources, and continued support from neighbors like you.

We need you to stay engaged. Visit our website for updates, volunteer opportunities, and ways to contribute to the cause. Together, we can make sure the City’s actions don’t go unchallenged and that College Park remains a safe, thriving place for generations to come.

Thank you for standing with us.

In solidarity,
**United College Park**

| Hi Friend, Melissa here, campaign manager for Stuart Whitlow for Congress.
One thing I've always admired about Stuart is how he puts in the work. Ask anyone around here, and they'll tell you about a time when Stuart's been there -- for them or someone they're close to.
Stuart exemplifies the values of this district: honesty, hard work, a can-do Texas neighborly-ness I've always looked up to.
And maybe that's especially noticeable, because of the noticeable absence of our current representative, John Carter.
You're not likely to see Carter in person, around here. He's spent the last 22 years living in Washington, and he hasn't held a Town Hall physically in our district -- in years.
Neither can you count on seeing John Carter in Congress. He's missed more than 125 Congressional votes this session -- and his prolonged absences have left our district voiceless.
Frankly, none of us are really sure what John Carter has been doing. And that deserves only one response -- it's time to replace him for a representative who can do the job.
[››› If you're ready for a new day in Texas 31, please chip in now.](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OKuwqvgoLFh_z4LTpQmbuO_Pv_8EUlY4rysdBkCePWcZqdbw2vnP8HfTsX6L_zxSJHAe1bqiZzllGBBngqV6VqQRmV-ff9uDvfF3K0tAUpv-Xh_ULzFYlulz93MpxQrBv3UpTSy3OP8aqPwj4eYbbJ51ZqSMhdAGgtdYWNN8N2EBBQ8LaxbR4WDygmEBafaC7rJ2X2hgftjY5lH772G9Iw==&c=1zNSt5XW3FO8pl1bMDHIa8spj9gLfpc5v6mjD6u8A_Bg1qGrLb5ikg==&ch=r9tuDzl8li5rQBDtKM8NJ0E8KRCjULzU-uoVcRdryKN0h9oIsxDFAQ==)
We deserve a Congressman who shows up, and who will show up for us.
A Congressman whose policies -- on the economy and reducing inflation, restoring our reproductive freedoms, treating veterans with the dignity they deserve, defending our democracy -- are compelling and vital in Texas' 31st Congressional District, like Stuart's are.
One whose experiences as a trial lawyer fighting for everyday Texans, as a community leader bringing the award-winning job training program, "Capital Idea," to Williamson County to help thousands seize better opportunities for their families, and now, out on the campaign trail, forging real connections with hundreds of people, have paved the way for Stuart's real, pragmatic leadership in Congress.
It is time to elect a Texan who's ready to lead: Stuart Whitlow.
Melissa Ross Campaign Manager, Whitlow for Congress

millions of suffering Palestinians for over a year.

Now, a new bombshell report suggests that Blinken approved Israel bombing
trucks carrying humanitarian aid into Gaza:

Netanyahu told Blinken last October “I have got people in the cabinet who
don’t want an aspirin to get into Gaza because of what’s happened.”
Reporters say Blinken was present and participated in discussions with

and medical supplies.

Since then, Israeli forces have shelled and bombed numerous aid trucks,
