name: COURIER
subject: Trump's hurricane lies are picking up speed
body:
Ahead of a second hurricane hitting Florida, the right-wing conspiracies around Helene have endangered residents

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94641376/504161663/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2Q5ZWQ0MzUtNjc4Ni1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FzNG3Kozez0uoq_qmCqC-o9D7g2AMKzS-xTzjfoiTb0=&emci=19950a68-5986-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=3d9ed435-6786-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Last week, Hurricane Helene tore through the Southeast, leaving over 200 dead and thousands missing across North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, and Tennessee.
**Now, as Florida braces for Hurricane Milton—a massive, once-in-a-century storm—Trump, JD Vance, and right-wing media are politicizing the crisis, spreading conspiracy theories that undermine rescue efforts.**
At first glance, these lies may seem too absurd to take seriously. Claims that Democrats are using “weather manipulation” or deliberately withholding aid from Republican districts might sound ridiculous, but they’re already having a dangerous impact. The head of FEMA even warned that this misinformation is “truly dangerous.”
[**We’ll delve into these conspiracies and how they're spreading in a moment, but first, if you support COURIER’s mission to counter right-wing misinformation with factual local reporting, can you chip in $17 today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94641378/504161664/-260044646?refcode=20241009-EM-TrumpMilton&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2Q5ZWQ0MzUtNjc4Ni1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FzNG3Kozez0uoq_qmCqC-o9D7g2AMKzS-xTzjfoiTb0=)
Trump and his MAGA allies are waging a two-front misinformation campaign, using the hurricanes to score political points.
**The first front is a smear campaign to make the Biden-Harris rescue response seem ineffective and partisan. **
Here, Trump is leading the charge, falsely claiming that the government is withholding aid from Republican voters, limiting support for hurricane victims to $750, and allocating emergency funds to migrants instead of disaster response.
**Trump backer and _X_ owner Elon Musk took these lies further by amplifying completely fabricated claims that North Carolina government officials were arresting FEMA officers. **
JD Vance and the Murdoch-owned _Wall Street Journal_ did their part in an op-ed published by the once-respected media property:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94641380/504161666/-260044646?refcode=20241009-EM-TrumpMilton&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2Q5ZWQ0MzUtNjc4Ni1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FzNG3Kozez0uoq_qmCqC-o9D7g2AMKzS-xTzjfoiTb0=)
Vance’s claims in the article have been debunked by the public statements of Republican governors in Tennessee and Georgia who praised the Biden-Harris response. According to a media report, North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper called Vance’s op-ed “appalling.”
The second set of lies is even more unhinged, propagated by far-right influencers on _X_ and TikTok.
These conspiracies accuse Democrats of using “weather manipulation” to harm Republicans, with wild claims backed by nothing more than a data collection flight by NOAA or a tweet from Marjorie Taylor Greene.
Now, as Hurricane Milton hits Florida, FEMA officials are concerned that people might be too scared to seek help because they believe these lies.

Team, **56%** That's how much maternal deaths rose in Texas after the state banned abortion — even with an exception for the life of the mother.

As an OB/GYN who's fought to provide the full scope of reproductive care to my patients for years, this is what I feared abortion bans would bring.

**That's why, when the MAGA Supreme Court struck down _Roe_ in 2022, I signed onto a lawsuit to block Wisconsin's 1849 abortion ban. I refused to let women in this state _die_.**

It's also why no matter what my opponent says, there is no such thing as a "moderate" abortion ban. Texas is proof that exceptions don't work — **women still die.**

**EMERGENCY ALERT: "Potentially catastrophic" Hurricane Milton set to strike Florida two weeks after Helene devastated the Southeast. ** **[Will you rush an emergency donation of $29 or more to help the USO support service members responding to these disasters?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/~)** *

This is just awful.
Florida is bracing for Hurricane Milton -- potentially the strongest Gulf storm in nearly 20 years -- to make landfall late Wednesday. As many as "15 million people are under flood watches ... and 11 million are at risk for tropical tornadoes." Communities not in Milton's direct path, including some that are still recovering from Hurricane Helene, are still at risk of excessive rainfall, flooding, storm surge, tornados and more.
Thousands of National Guard and active-duty service members are already deployed across the Southeast supporting communities that were devastated by Hurricane Helene _less than two weeks ago_. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Did you catch Kamala’s Medicare announcement?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I was thrilled to see Kamala Harris speak so passionately on The View about her plan to allow Medicare to cover in-home care for seniors.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241009-4380-footer&t=1&akid=4380%2E420207%2E411O9k)
Peter,
As Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, I’ve been working hard to protect and expand Medicare. **So I was thrilled to see Kamala Harris speak so passionately on The View about her plan to expand Medicare to cover in-home care for seniors:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241009-1?refcode=em20241009-1&amount=3&refcode2=4380_420207_411O9k&akid=4380%2E420207%2E411O9k)
This issue is deeply personal for so many families across the country. **Kamala’s plan is game-changing** for the “sandwich generation” who are caring for both their aging parents and their children.
Years ago, when I first introduced the most comprehensive Medicare For All bill in the House, my legislation was the first to include coverage for long-term care. It was a crisis then and it remains a crisis now.
Today, almost 700,000 Americans are on a waiting list to qualify for home and community based care. A recent investigation by the _New York Times_ found nearly three million older Americans who need long-term help are not receiving it, in large part because of the high costs of assisted living facilities, nursing homes and aides at home. COVID both exacerbated and highlighted the tremendous financial, emotional, and physical burdens for millions of American families to care for their loved ones.
All of us know what it’s like to watch a family member age, and families everywhere are struggling to figure out how to afford care for their loved ones. That’s where Kamala’s new policy announcement comes in.
It’s not just that assisted living centers are prohibitively expensive. As Kamala said, this is about dignity for the person who needs care. Many times seniors would prefer to stay in their own homes and remain as independent as they can, and we need to help make that a realistic option for as many of them as possible.
**Plus, making the wealthy and Big Pharma help pay for this investment is _exactly_ what we need to do.** We’ve already allowed Medicare to negotiate some drug prices, and it’s time to open it up to even more so that taxpayers aren’t getting gouged by multi-billion dollar pharmaceutical companies that post record profits year after year.
But Peter, in order for any of this to happen, we need to make sure Kamala Harris is sworn in as president next January. My campaign is teaming up with the Harris-Walz campaign to conduct virtual phone banks in swing states across the country, and we need your support to keep up this critical outreach work.
[**If you’re with me in the fight to expand Medicare, will you split a donation of $3 between my campaign and the Harris-Walz campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241009-1?refcode=em20241009-1&amount=3&refcode2=4380_420207_411O9k&akid=4380%2E420207%2E411O9k)

Together,
Pramila Jayapal

Wade_ and states across the country immediately began enacting draconian laws to control women’s bodies and choices, one thing became abundantly clear: Reproductive freedom will be on the ballot in November. Already we’re seeing so many shameful and heartbreaking impacts of extreme abortion bans — the rising infant mortality rate in Texas, the seventh-grader forced to become a mom in Mississippi. And safe havens for reproductive rights are becoming fewer and farther between: **Right now, Virginia is the _only remaining state in the South without an abortion ban in place._** We’ve got to fight these unjust restrictions at the state level and in the courts, and there are activists on the ground across the country who are doing just that. But there’s one clear action that we can and must take at the federal level if we want to ensure women have bodily autonomy: Congress must codify the protections of _Roe_ into federal law. Fellow American,

I hate to be so direct.

But that’s the only choice I have right now. Our campaign is faltering financially. Jon Tester’s record-breaking fundraising numbers are simply burying us.

Every day, he doubles or triples our fundraising numbers, and some days, he beats us by a ratio of 10 to 1. **[Help us out.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=41b7449989b94273822ef1c0a8cac265&_e=Uu_HYnE2puelSeuDzlqLma6pGS6I9E7GQ3Go7d7uniFvMZ28PDryQ69-Id2pLJUuuGsXF7z2gmb9q7C09MAD0rAckkHn96Rf480ATCj6LtPnr_BUBfO40EssA_A8sOT2BXkGfxwHhjzYQH1DWWh2PwKXviTnsgz6dHz32rvO8ZpZ00oVe8Jlqd9gFBkSIxFq9LmLl5KAlRZXhrHUl2bIc8xVvBKP3oVTeemtHpGZK29213UmDyQb6qfpIN_McTyDcJBfQ6g4lx6OW5oX1aIP-2KSBp7dMgl5JL27nfyxrcpVO1vh2RVXeFJCQksw-dEFv3wbUEP55y8stfaHFMxg6dEeFRfVZ7NOjiFVe-ajj5KMDiiRBLSb33H2fNT1dXjGQ8w1C3Q-V0GKaAgdS7nqjg%3D%3D)**

**
We have an unbelievable opportunity in this election.**

We can give America the honest, fearless conservative representation much needed in the U.S. Senate.

This headline says it all, Team.
Arizona made "no-excuse" early and mail-in voting legal back in 1991. For decades, Arizona's mail-in voting laws were the model of ballot accessibility, making it easy for voters to participate in their elections. An overwhelming majority of Arizona voters voted early, either in person at a polling place or via mail-in ballot.
But opponents of voting rights in the Arizona House of Representatives voted to change all that. They voted along straight party lines to pass a bill that would end early voting in the state -- both in person and by mail with just a handful of exceptions for the elderly or those in military service. This sends the bill onto the Arizona Senate, possibly setting up a showdown with Gov. Katie Hobbs over a potential veto.
This is bad news for Arizona voters and bad news for everyone that cares about our democracy. Help us stop suppressive bills like this in Arizona and across the country with $25 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=100924_2&amount=25]

**Don’t miss our special program this weekend!** On Saturday, October 12, _The Art of Democracy_ for a making workshop and community discussion . Exhibiting artist Penny Mateer will lead a making workshop, Pole-2-Polls. For the past ten years, fiber artist Penny Mateer has engaged the Pittsburgh and Allegheny County communities around art making and voting rights. Pole-2-Polls is a volunteer-run and community-led project for the creation of nonpartisan lawn and garden VOTE! signs. It originates from the recycling of cloth from past projects, including the enveloping of the railings of the Andy Warhol Bridge in downtown Pittsburgh. #
Friend of Life,

Did you know that America's most popular diaper brands, including Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support abortion?

This is peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally kills innocent children in the womb.

As pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

**Live Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife -- the first pro-life diaper company -- to help mothers and their babies in need.**

If you're tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life values, you can do something now to help women AND support a pro-life business.

**Your gift of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her embrace life. Our goal is to provide 34 boxes of diapers to every state.**

Here's your secure link to give: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=37ad13a15ac3437087001dbe33742363&_e=C4ahd2uI389suIgm9aAgP-O3DPiAMEVGtHpmG0PbbXJN5rvnJ6DbEY44XMfuThx-1AW9pKah2GpdtRfBH-IgFtE744R1hJ5WMTsFf0F9IuQNBx2dvlvkPFQn4lvX-jsg9v-gtWWHZQtU3rpTCYc061UYHWVgxO0X-CXNkdeetDDs1zFj9tbpZ5766-3R4PknodMPuLrnFQto48Yw7f1a3XX4CCju31k-xlKx2M6OGyKJ-8O1UAdWOlipk43NZXH6eoDZRvnCenRKShAdTxHKR06pqYvs3p9pdGBk4ITr9Yr3ks83dfs0V_0dq5suja-cZqMr1UTUIwDJg0U9Oay_yBXoVN3_04aG8SEwAvmY8crN7NdZdQazKkRfjll9_OMpyFEE2NYEFr6G-vVF5w-djw%3D%3D)**

EveryLife prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium materials for their diapers-- and better yet, EveryLife promotes the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

Lila Rose

He made it clear that Debbie is the only candidate in this race who will protect our Social Security and Medicare, reproductive freedoms, and who will fight for an affordable Florida. Our freedoms are on the line, and he knows Debbie is the one to defend them. I know you’re with us, Peter, when we say we’re FIRED UP and READY TO GO!! President Obama knows how to win tough races — and he knows that this is one of the closest races in the country. That’s why he’s all in on the Florida Senate seat as one of our best chances to protect the Senate majority and Americans’ fundamental freedoms. # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 9, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com
**Kevin Faulconer Blasts Terra Lawson-Remer for Voting Against Prop 36, Ignoring Bipartisan Calls for Change**
San Diego, CA — Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, today criticized Terra Lawson-Remer’s vote against Proposition 36, which has garnered widespread support from leaders across the political spectrum throughout California. Prop 36, aimed at reversing the leniency of Prop 47 by holding repeat offenders accountable and addressing California’s spike in smash-and-grab crimes, has become a focal point in the state’s criminal justice reform debate.
_**“Lawson-Remer doesn’t care about what’s happening on our streets,” Faulconer said. “She’s been an absent Supervisor, and it shows – she doesn’t show up to any meetings of the homeless task force she serves in. She previously said, ‘we don’t need Prop 36’ and that couldn’t be more out of touch with what our communities are facing. Crime is a real concern; homelessness is skyrocketing and the residents of San Diego deserve a leader who understands the gravity of the situation. Terra doesn’t get it, and she doesn’t care.”**_
Faulconer pointed to the [broad bipartisan support](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=f21755b62d&e=784f78234b) for Prop 36, including endorsements from law enforcement, business owners, community leaders and elected officials from all sides of the aisle throughout California.
_**“When people from all walks of life are calling for change, it shows just how crucial Prop 36 is for the safety and security of our neighborhoods. We need real solutions to stop smash-and-grab crimes, and Terra Lawson-Remer’s opposition only highlights her failure to stand up for our communities.”**_
Faulconer pledged to work across the aisle – as he has previously as San Diego’s Mayor – to ensure San Diego County becomes a safer place, starting with addressing the rise in crime and the need to have consequences for actions. It’s a big reason why the law enforcement community overwhelmingly backs Kevin Faulconer for Supervisor.
For more information on Kevin Faulconer’s _****_[_**strong record of success and bipartisan cooperation**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=bcb7ba38d3&e=784f78234b) to address the challenges we face as a county, please visit: [www.kevinfaulconer.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=5f899c9778&e=784f78234b)
For more information about Terra Lawson-Remer’s [_**long list**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=1555ea71ff&e=784f78234b) of failures, please visit [www.terraisntworking.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=d6c4d2ea06&e=784f78234b)

**Contact:** Griffin Reid, Communications Director, _**[greid@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**_

_**AG Rokita Raises Over $1 Million in Last 3 Months
**_ **INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (October 9, 2024)** – Attorney General Todd Rokita's campaign has raised over $1 million in the last quarter, taking his total cash on hand to over $2 million going into October. This level of support from Hoosiers across the state is a testament to Attorney General Todd Rokita's success in serving Indiana. We are just 27 days away from election day, and early voting has started. Democrats are doing everything they can to flip this office blue, along with all our statewide offices. We need to continue to support Todd Rokita and the rest of our Republican ticket.
---
_**Statement from Indiana GOP Executive Director Josh Waddell:**_
---
"Attorney General Todd Rokita's impressive fundraising this quarter, surpassing $1 million and bringing his total cash on hand to over $2 million, demonstrates the unwavering support he has from Hoosiers across the state. This is a clear endorsement of his continued dedication to protecting Indiana values and fighting for Hoosiers.

As we near Election Day with early voting already underway, it's more important than ever to rally behind Attorney General Rokita and the rest of our Republican ticket. Democrats are pulling out all the stops to take this seat and others statewide, but with the continued support of Republicans statewide, we can ensure Indiana remains in capable, conservative hands."
---

| | Have you followed the latest coming from college and university campuses in America?

In 2024, revolutionary leftists and rent-a-mob organizations funded by progressive billionaires occupied elite universities across the country.

Many of these universities canceled classes and commencement due to pro-terror protests. Police have arrested students and even professors at several institutions due to violence!

That's why I need to hear from you right away. What do you think about all of this?
**Could you please take a few minutes to complete our National Survey on Higher Education and let me know your thoughts[today](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=663fd2fc52ac43bf8667cdf1c08ab493&_e=87Ktf-wXlPxdEOr5ZMVqQ8yYD4MF7rd6NHLcr_tsK1gbHHyGnbRhFVKlvmm2Lzy_oM29Ry3HY7N0aYOkc-gcLw2FQCes9ue8b8TMO_6V2KdDB2TOxRfvWlNhUFGdKG4oJieEvvYWj9k4-xHIX_-SB-Dvn2WFvA1oxPdSwUoTjL11MVnmBz_xqMMLsev0rD1yI4PZYzincAEkGDS4DrbDFpmHW4iVLIagZjqsaJTXCFYzOnYDIIMBotUqXybRWRA0rSGotp0tOfzR2ZHlDCTiZElcpVCTdxV2zs0ICP6iv9BoyJKZQyktTMh44I5RblCT0D1lvVlkcAgRk4RKB9WdxL_sLIredoz7AEmk9fm0z1zNdWrF3PXbzKDvF7OJip8D_Mje4j9_wfC9qrskaSA9Iw%3D%3D)?**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=663fd2fc52ac43bf8667cdf1c08ab493&_e=87Ktf-wXlPxdEOr5ZMVqQ8yYD4MF7rd6NHLcr_tsK1gbHHyGnbRhFVKlvmm2Lzy_oM29Ry3HY7N0aYOkc-gcLw2FQCes9ue8b8TMO_6V2KdDB2TOxRfvWlNhUFGdKG4oJieEvvYWj9k4-xHIX_-SB-Dvn2WFvA1oxPdSwUoTjL11MVnmBz_xqMMLsev0rD1yI4PZYzincAEkGDS4DrbDFpmHW4iVLIagZjqsaJTXCFYzOnYDIIMBotUqXybRWRA0ztMraQHYwY7HLXLWBco_wOgxNydeLpojUloFohe9yw73xvvy4nZn9VQ8Rm_cRh9s0-qvq6fsbELWksr07DbQ7XokozoDu-onJzOZlkn9FRzNrz1mcVXhUyJjlKDghz67JX4GHiIrAvNlWgpiFT6xEA%3D%3D)

It's no secret that these campus radicals get their inspiration from the student protestors of 1968...

Our country has changed a lot since that year. And I would say--and I think you agree--not for the better.

A big reason is that many of these radicals took over our education system...as professors, administrators, and government bureaucrats.

And they spread far-Left propaganda in our schools and culture with the help of big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars.

**Hillsdale College is one of the _only_ colleges in this country that hasn't fallen into this madness. **

We are one of the _only_ colleges that teach young Americans--and millions of people around this country--what makes our country the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

**But in response to the violent mobs we see in far too many colleges and universities, we need YOUR HELP to do even more. We must reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty, far beyond Hillsdale 's campus. **

We refuse to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly, in the form of federal or state student grants and loans.

This independence frees us from burdensome and corrupting regulations. It's why our college is a place that seeks to DEFEND LIBERTY rather than OVERTHROW IT.

But it comes at a cost! We rely heavily on the generosity of friends like you to do our work.

So, would you consider chipping in to help us **reach** and **teach** millions more citizens nationwide?

**You can teach millions** --everyone from the high school senior who takes a civics course in one of our K-12 classical schools using our **free** curriculum ...

...to the family who reads _Imprimis_ --our **free** digest of liberty--and engages in a lively discussion at the dinner table over what Heather Mac Donald, Victor Davis Hanson, or Christopher Rufo had to say ...

...to the grandparents who watch our **free** online courses on the Constitution and American history and tell stories to their grandchildren about the great heroes of liberty.

When elite schools are doing everything they can to destroy this country, you can change this country for the better--one person, one family, one community at a time.

So, after you take our survey, please consider supporting us once again.

Any gift you can give from **$10** , **$25** , **$35** , or even **$50** , if you've been especially blessed this year, will help us relentlessly pursue our mission on behalf of liberty--especially when our higher education is in crisis. But we need your help right away.

I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on Higher Education** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=663fd2fc52ac43bf8667cdf1c08ab493&_e=87Ktf-wXlPxdEOr5ZMVqQ8yYD4MF7rd6NHLcr_tsK1gbHHyGnbRhFVKlvmm2Lzy_oM29Ry3HY7N0aYOkc-gcLw2FQCes9ue8b8TMO_6V2KdDB2TOxRfvWlNhUFGdKG4oJieEvvYWj9k4-xHIX_-SB-Dvn2WFvA1oxPdSwUoTjL11MVnmBz_xqMMLsev0rD1yI4PZYzincAEkGDS4DrbDFpmHW4iVLIagZjqsaJTXCFYzOnYDIIMBotUqXybRWRA03Ci9rbmjU9iULjzlVy8mZaryjX5Yi2wOGqFll6I7FwqC90NHDolbZZTvuRBza_xdN5dNNEVY8IlvqDwlUWhxKJy7EIP4XbwNcTZgtE1A_GN-6MYXxfD3cXh62B8eERzqEICmLZD-iumrZbSWcgaqYg%3D%3D)

Thank you in advance for letting me know your thoughts.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Big-money progressive donors and your tax dollars have helped far-Left activists, administrators, and bureaucrats take over elite colleges and universities. That's why you see these places erupt in protests--and even violent mobs--that have led to canceled classes and commencements, and even the arrests of students and professors.

That's why I'm asking you today to take Hillsdale College's **National Survey on Higher Education**. It'll only take a few minutes. You can find our survey at the secure link here:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/higher-education-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=663fd2fc52ac43bf8667cdf1c08ab493&_e=87Ktf-wXlPxdEOr5ZMVqQ8yYD4MF7rd6NHLcr_tsK1gbHHyGnbRhFVKlvmm2Lzy_oM29Ry3HY7N0aYOkc-gcLw2FQCes9ue8b8TMO_6V2KdDB2TOxRfvWlNhUFGdKG4oJieEvvYWj9k4-xHIX_-SB-Dvn2WFvA1oxPdSwUoTjL11MVnmBz_xqMMLsev0rD1yI4PZYzincAEkGDS4DrbDFpmHW4iVLIagZjqsaJTXCFYzOnYDIIMBotUqXybRWRA03QKsALZRX4oJUqtC60rfNW-A3pNuxzJBeCeqBEA8a0UOK4Z2iCYABmqGETzDuTFuzFz7pMTxXY66y2E-KMbMvEyWnOStzD4esbWaSInRHrgJMa6ltapyVTpmG8VWUwm4t8kbEGNk6pBRTP2X-7LEpw%3D%3D)**

Thanks again!

clean_body: This election is going to be close. And we all have to get in the fight to elect Kamala and Tim. | | | Peter, I’m going to get right to it: ** Look, I know you know what the stakes are in this election. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz want to build an Opportunity Economy for all Americans. Creating more good-paying jobs, cutting costs for families, and making it easier to afford a first home. And yes: ensuring the ultra-rich finally pay their fair share in taxes. That sounds pretty good to me. What are Donald Trump and JD Vance promising? More tax handouts for their billionaire friends and mega corporations. A Trump sales tax on everyday goods costing families $4,000 more every year. And even more attempts to repeal the Affordable Care Act, which would jack up our health care and prescription costs. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are fighting for the middle class because they’re from the middle class. We saw who Donald Trump fought for when he was in office: himself. We deserve better than that. We’ve got to do everything we can right now to ensure Trump and Vance stay far, far away from the White House. | | We don’t get what we don’t fight for. And every action adds up to make a real difference. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | | | |

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Michael Baumgartner
subject: We had a great debate at Gonzaga.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vote Baumgartner for Congress | (509) 370-8398 | www
body:
Looking forward to more opportunities to share our message.

** Great debate at Gonzaga University
------------------------------------------------------------

Throughout my political career I’ve always enjoyed sharing my message with the voters and drawing contrasts with my opponents on the issues.

Last night we had the opportunity for a debate at Gonzaga University co-hosted by The Spokesman/Northwest Passages, KSPS, and The Black Lens.

I appreciated being able to highlight the need to secure the southern border, stop fentanyl and help the economy grow by reducing onerous regulations.

The debate will be re-broadcast on KSPS tomorrow, Thursday October 10, at 7pm.

A big thank you to supporters who were able to attend the debate. We really appreciated you being with us in the audience!

I’m looking forward to two more debates coming up:

October 21: Foley Institute at WSU, Pullman - co-hosted by KHQ (open only to invited students/guests)

October 30: KREM debate, broadcast live 7:00-8:00pm (no studio audience)

** Recent Endorsements
------------------------------------------------------------

I’ve been honored by a number of recent endorsements:
* Washington Farm Bureau
* Washington Council of Police & Sheriffs (WACOPs)
* Spokane Police Guild
* National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB)
* Polaris National Security
* Amb. Ryan Crocker
* AIPAC

...and many more supporters from across the 5th District. Thank you!

** Remembering October 7
------------------------------------------------------------

I was honored to join the Jewish community in Spokane this week for a remembrance ceremony in honor of the victims of last year’s horrific attacks.

Our family is praying for the remaining hostages, for a strong and secure Israel, and for peace for everyone in the Middle East.

** Letters to the Editor
------------------------------------------------------------

We were grateful for this supportive letter:

The Spokesman Review: Be inspired for vote for Baumgartner

“...Michael has deep roots in Eastern Washington. Like our four children, he is a proud WSU graduate. But he left the safety of the Pacific Northwest to serve our country in the Middle East through economic development and foreign policy initiatives. We also got to know Michael’s wife Eleanor, a former journalist who had worked alongside him amid the conflict in Afghanistan, and we have loved watching their family grow to include five amazing children.

Michael Baumgartner did a wonderful job of representing us in the state Senate. He worked to bring our new WSU medical school to Spokane, to get our North-South freeway funded and to make a courageous stand for Eastern Washington values every day in Olympia. His most recent role has been serving Spokane County as its treasurer.

We feel very fortunate that Michael wants to take his intellect, abilities and heartfelt desire to help others to the halls of Congress. ..”

Russ and Carol Roeber, Spokane

Click here (https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2024/oct/06/letters-for-oct-6-2024/)

Please help us spread the word about the campaign by writing to your local newspaper! If you would like support with a letter to the editor, please reach out to the campaign here (mailto:eleanor@votebaumgartner.com?subject=Letter%20to%20the%20Editor&body=) .

We also have volunteers knocking on doors every weekend as part of a combined team with other local and statewide Republican campaigns. Please contact (mailto:erich@votebaumgartner.com?subject=I%20would%20like%20to%20help!&body=) us if you can help!

Thank you for your support and encouragement.

Let’s win!

-Michael

To: NDRC “Team Arizona”
Re: Early vote update Today’s the first day of in-person early voting and ballot-by-mail voting in Arizona — one of our most consequential 2024 electoral priorities. We’re here with an update on four key things: **Knowing the dates **
As a member of “Team Arizona,” we’re counting on you to help make sure everyone you know in the state — and everyone they know — is aware of and talking about these key dates: | 🗳️First day of early voting: **TODAY** , Oct 9th
📪County Recorder offices start ballot-by-mail processes: **TODAY** , Oct 9th
📩Last day to apply for ballot by mail (received, not postmarked): Friday, Oct 25th
🙋Last day of in-person early voting: Friday, Nov 1st
🇺🇸Election Day: Tuesday, Nov 5th
---
It’s so important that we help folks — _especially_ sporadic voters who we _really_ need to turn out — make their plans to vote. If voters aren’t aware that they can vote early, or aren’t thinking about their plan for Tuesday, November 5th, it’s possible they could miss their chance to cast their ballot.
[**You can make sure voters know how — and when! — to cast their ballot. Donate to help get out the vote in key races across the country.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94648629/504185075/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AZDeepDive_email_20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_campaign=AZDeepDive&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0Y2I2MDU3LTc3ODYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mk9Lixt7NAJlbqSOwdX9tqw2mrkq8el1K1tWxsB6NzY=)
**Flipping the chambers**
As a reminder, in Arizona, Republicans hold just a _two-seat majority_ in BOTH the state House and Senate. A top elections expert has ranked _both_ state legislative chambers as toss-ups. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
[**You can help establish key firewalls against Republican anti-democracy agendas across the country. Contribute to make sure priority races have the resources they need.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94648630/504185076/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AZDeepDive_email_20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_campaign=AZDeepDive&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0Y2I2MDU3LTc3ODYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mk9Lixt7NAJlbqSOwdX9tqw2mrkq8el1K1tWxsB6NzY=)
**Unseating election deniers **
A recent report from Democracy Docket, leveraging data from Public Wise’s _Election Thread Index_ , identified THIRTY THREE election deniers **up for reelection** in Arizona in November:
* 9 state senators
* 16 state representatives
* 2 county recorders
* 6 members of the County Board of Supervisors

According to the Democracy Docket, all of these candidates _currently_ hold public office and “have publicly taken actions and positions that denied or attempted to overturn the results of an election, or undermined the results of an election.”
Arizonans deserve better representation than elected officials who refuse to protect the very foundations of our democracy. [**You can help protect our electoral process. Chip in to help elect pro-democracy leaders across the country.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94648631/504185077/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AZDeepDive_email_20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_campaign=AZDeepDive&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0Y2I2MDU3LTc3ODYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mk9Lixt7NAJlbqSOwdX9tqw2mrkq8el1K1tWxsB6NzY=)
**Understanding the stakes in the State Supreme Court**
There are two big things going on here:
First, two of seven seats are up for retention. We’re supporting a _massive_ organizing effort underway to oust two extreme judges who recently voted to uphold a 19th-century abortion ban and replace them with pro-democracy leaders who believe in protecting our fundamental freedoms.
And second, there is a ballot initiative, Proposition 137 — the Judicial Accountability Act of 2024 — that would _end term limits_ for state supreme and appellate court judges. It would essentially _cancel future elections_ for these seats.
_And get this, Peter: Prop 137 would be **retroactive**! _
That means if Prop 137 passes, the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice would be nullified. **So if Prop 137 passes, the conservative majority in the state supreme court “freezes” in place. **
It’s an enormous abuse of power, and it’s no coincidence it was introduced this year. Help make it clear: A "no" vote opposes ending term limits. A "yes" vote on Prop 137 _takes power away from voters_ after they cast their ballots. [**You can help fight back against extreme MAGA leaders who are doing whatever they can to maintain power. Donate to help educate voters across the country what’s at stake this election.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94648632/504185078/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_AZDeepDive_email_20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241009-NDRC-Tier1-AZDeepDive_&utm_campaign=AZDeepDive&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0Y2I2MDU3LTc3ODYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=mk9Lixt7NAJlbqSOwdX9tqw2mrkq8el1K1tWxsB6NzY=)

clean_body: We’re here with an update on four key things: | To: NDRC “Team Arizona” Re: Early vote update Today’s the first day of in-person early voting and ballot-by-mail voting in Arizona — one of our most consequential 2024 electoral priorities. We’re here with an update on four key things: Knowing the dates As a member of “Team Arizona,” we’re counting on you to help make sure everyone you know in the state — and everyone they know — is aware of and talking about these key dates: | 🗳️First day of early voting: TODAY , Oct 9th 📪County Recorder offices start ballot-by-mail processes: TODAY , Oct 9th 📩Last day to apply for ballot by mail (received, not postmarked): Friday, Oct 25th 🙋Last day of in-person early voting: Friday, Nov 1st 🇺🇸Election Day: Tuesday, Nov 5th It’s so important that we help folks — especially sporadic voters who we really need to turn out — make their plans to vote. If voters aren’t aware that they can vote early, or aren’t thinking about their plan for Tuesday, November 5th, it’s possible they could miss their chance to cast their ballot. = Flipping the chambers As a reminder, in Arizona, Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in BOTH the state House and Senate. A top elections expert has ranked both state legislative chambers as toss-ups. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process. = Unseating election deniers A recent report from Democracy Docket, leveraging data from Public Wise’s Election Thread Index , identified THIRTY THREE election deniers up for reelection in Arizona in November: 9 state senators 16 state representatives 2 county recorders 6 members of the County Board of Supervisors According to the Democracy Docket, all of these candidates currently hold public office and “have publicly taken actions and positions that denied or attempted to overturn the results of an election, or undermined the results of an election.” Arizonans deserve better representation than elected officials who refuse to protect the very foundations of our democracy. = Understanding the stakes in the State Supreme Court There are two big things going on here: First, two of seven seats are up for retention. We’re supporting a massive organizing effort underway to oust two extreme judges who recently voted to uphold a 19th-century abortion ban and replace them with pro-democracy leaders who believe in protecting our fundamental freedoms. And second, there is a ballot initiative, Proposition 137 — the Judicial Accountability Act of 2024 — that would end term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges. It would essentially cancel future elections for these seats. And get this, Peter: Prop 137 would be retroactive! That means if Prop 137 passes, the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice would be nullified. So if Prop 137 passes, the conservative majority in the state supreme court “freezes” in place. It’s an enormous abuse of power, and it’s no coincidence it was introduced this year. Help make it clear: A "no" vote opposes ending term limits. A "yes" vote on Prop 137 takes power away from voters after they cast their ballots. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = As voters begin casting their ballots, the urgency increases to a whole new level. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
This could swing the election our way in battleground states.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39170%2E3422442%2ETHW_iG)
Derek,
With early voting underway in many states and Election Day just weeks away, every moment counts to prevent Trump from regaining the White House. One of my favorite political organizations, Vote Common Good, is taking action.
I've been a proud partner with Vote Common Good from the very beginning. We connected during my first run for Congress, and I am proud to be a Common Good Candidate. Over the years, I've seen firsthand how their tactics move the needle with faith voters who are on the fence about their political identity in the age of Trump.
Their "His Words Matter" billboard campaign was critical in flipping critical swing states like Pennsylvania, Michigan, and Wisconsin in 2020—and ultimately defeating Donald Trump.
Now, they need our help to do it again, but on an even bigger scale.
**These billboards highlight Trump's own cruel, reckless words, reminding voters of the damage he's done to our democracy and decency.**
Things he's actually said, like:
"Support me, or you'll be so god@#mn poor." "I'd bomb the s@it out of them." "People are dying. It is what it is." "If they stay poor for generations...they're morons." "I'd like to punch him in the face."
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241009?refcode=em20241009-39170&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39170_3422442_THW_iG&akid=39170%2E3422442%2ETHW_iG)
The billboards juxtapose these with the words of Jesus, creating a stark contrast that sparks crucial conversations among faith voters.
**Vote Common Good has set an ambitious goal to blanket Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Arizona, and Georgia with these billboards, and the first ones went up this week. But they need to raise another $30,000 by the end of this week to keep them up through Election Day.**
**[Your contribution will help put these powerful messages in front of voters in important battleground states and help keep Trump out of the White House. Can you join me in supporting Vote Common Good’s work with a donation of $25, $50, $100, $250, or whatever you can give right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241009?refcode=em20241009-39170&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39170_3422442_THW_iG&akid=39170%2E3422442%2ETHW_iG)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20241009?refcode=em20241009-39170&refcode2=39170_3422442_THW_iG&akid=39170%2E3422442%2ETHW_iG)
As an elected official, I know that our words matter. The president’s words _especially_ matter. These words shape our national dialogue and influence our national conscience.
We can't let Trump's hateful rhetoric go unchallenged. With your support, we can remind voters that Trump's words reveal what's in his heart—and that his heart stands in direct opposition to the values that so many Americans hold dear.
Thanks for stepping up,
Katie

Can I explain something, Peter?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**
And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.

— Jon

# A Hurricane of Lies
---
| I grew up in a hurricane prone area of Texas,and I still remember boarding up our housein Corpus Christi and waiting for the worstto come in the days before a storm.
Right now, we are on the brink of a catastrophic hurricane in Florida – less than two weeks after [the devastation caused in North Carolina](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=894f158d76&e=395a33a3d2) by one of the worst storms in modern history.
---
[](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=6993dea07f&e=395a33a3d2)
| [Hurricane Helene led to a surge in disinformation](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=016e894c67&e=395a33a3d2), thanks to [Donald Trump](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=603ffab00a&e=395a33a3d2) and [Chip](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=2a30e47299&e=395a33a3d2) [Roy](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=95b572a959&e=395a33a3d2).
It was on a doorstep that I first heard the far-right lie that the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)is [out of money because they used it to ](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=f07bbce6a1&e=395a33a3d2)[put up illegal immigrants in fancy hotels](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=2f9d1c0c76&e=395a33a3d2).
The truth is [Congress sets spending priorities and ](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=aa0ebfc24d&e=395a33a3d2)[allocates taxpayer dollars](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=adc64466db&e=395a33a3d2) to fund specific programs like the [Disaster Relief Fund](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=17bfea5890&e=395a33a3d2) – an entirely separate program from the [Shelter and Services Program](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=b4b1a02558&e=395a33a3d2) that FEMA administers from a separate pool of money.
**If anyone is to blame for FEMA not having enough****funds to make it through hurricane season,****it is the current ineffective Congress and Chip Roy.**
Just two weeks ago, [Republicans voted against](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=b424f0798c&e=395a33a3d2)[FEMA Funding](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=a985f0fb4d&e=395a33a3d2), and you’ll never guess who was on the list.
---
| This isn’t the first time that Chip has held up disaster relief funds in our country.
In 2021, [Chip was one of 175 Republicans to](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=5e09289e45&e=395a33a3d2)[vote against FEMA’s Disaster Fund](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=52a30166e5&e=395a33a3d2).
**And in 2019,**[**Chip single-handedly blocked a**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=94db8fed6b&e=395a33a3d2)[**bipartisan agreement on disaster relief aid**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=bf4742438c&e=395a33a3d2)**.**
---
[](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=ca67ea76f4&e=395a33a3d2)
| **This is precisely why we must #FlipChip. **
Chip has shown us time and again thathe is unfit to serve in public office. Whether you live in our district or not, Chip Roy is your problem too.
We deserve leaders who will stand by their oath to serve the American people, not play politics with our lives.
[**With less than 30 days left until election day,**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=ffa39f6c40&e=395a33a3d2)[**pitch in what you can TODAY so voters**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=6edf1b96c2&e=395a33a3d2)[**in our district know that they have a better choice this**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=23b0d0fce4&e=395a33a3d2)[**election year who will always put us first!**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=0f5faf6823&e=395a33a3d2)

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonunthinkable?refcode=1009 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonunthinkable?refcode=1009]
Friends,
When my friend Andi’s daughter was diagnosed with leukemia at 8 1⁄2 weeks pregnant, she faced the most difficult decision a mother could make. Seeking lifesaving chemotherapy treatment would mean terminating her pregnancy.
Under a national abortion ban, Andi’s daughter wouldn’t have been able to have that choice. She - and her unborn child - would have died.
Please watch Andi’s story. It’s powerful, and every voter in our district needs to understand the choice in front of them:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonunthinkable?refcode=1009 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonunthinkable?refcode=1009]
I hope you’ll watch and share this far and wide.
My opponent, in his own words, supports the Supreme Court repealing Roe v. Wade. And he wants to throw out New York’s own law that protects abortion access.
There couldn’t be a bigger contrast. I believe that the decision to have an abortion should be between a woman, her doctor and her god - not the government. It’s a fact that the rising right wing tide of abortion bans is putting women’s lives at risk.
When in Congress, I’ll do everything in my power to stop a national abortion ban.
Nick LaLota would make abortion illegal in New York. I will protect a woman’s right to make choices about her own body.
That’s the choice in this election.
Thank you for standing with me and fighting the good fight.
-John

It’s a fact that the rising right wing tide of abortion bans is putting women’s lives at risk. When in Congress, I’ll do everything in my power to stop a national abortion ban. Nick LaLota would make abortion illegal in New York. I will protect a woman’s right to make choices about her own body. That’s the choice in this election. Thank you for standing with me and fighting the good fight. -John CONTRIBUTE [] PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS John Avlon for Congress PO Box 1200 Sag Harbor, NY 11963 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Barbarism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
If we do not assert ourselves and enshrine our rights — and demand healthcare, and education, and dignity — the alternative is barbarism, which is what we are contending with now.
The fact that people are choosing between medicine and rent is barbarism.
The fact that people are worried about whether they will be on the streets every 4 weeks is barbarism.
The fact that every time a person has an ache or a pain, and they’re scared that it could either be a sore joint or cancer, but they can’t find out because they can’t afford the doctor? **This is barbarism.**
If we do not demand — and not only demand, but win — unions, healthcare, wages, and ending endless war, then we will condemn ourselves to barbarism.
I refuse to give up. I refuse to submit myself to that future. That’s not a life.
**And so to live, we have to fight for each other. We have to stand with each other. We have to fight for this vision and this world.**
[If you can, will you make a $5 contribution – or any amount that is meaningful to you – to help power our fight for transformative change? Every donation will make a difference.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241009.sjCGCQ&refcode=em20241009-7363-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7363%2E2526796%2EChDdLk)

Alexandria

body:
Volunteer in Key States | |
---
| | | As we enter the final weeks of the campaign to elect Vice President Harris as our next President, many of you have asked what more you can do. In response, here is a [form](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=b642351519&e=43463f1dee) you can use to sign up to support final push efforts in battleground states.

If you are a faith leader or community member passionate about making a meaningful impact in the final stages of the 2024 election, we invite you to [complete this form](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=d40c9c956d&e=43463f1dee). **We are seeking dedicated volunteers to join the Harris-Walz campaign in key battleground states (AZ, GA, MI, NC, NV, PA, WI). **This opportunity involves traveling to one of these states to support the campaign's critical efforts, including canvassing, voter outreach, and other strategic activities designed to energize voters and ensure their voices are heard. Your participation can help shape the future of our nation—join us in taking action and making a difference when it matters most!

**If you’re not able to deploy in one of these states but would like to support in other ways, please **[**fill out this form**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=cffa56fa0f&e=43463f1dee)** to share how you’d like to participate.** Please [**share this opportunity with your networks**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=18866eafac&e=43463f1dee).

Please also pray for the voters and those working to engage voters in these battleground states.

Thank you for prayerfully considering this opportunity and for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

#
Here are some facts, Peter:
**🔵 Our grassroots campaign has broken records at every opportunity.** Between breaking Missouri fundraising records each quarter and earning the earliest-ever endorsements for a Senate challenger from the Missouri AFL-CIO and Missouri Fire Fighters, we’ve built a historic movement to flip this Senate seat.
**🔵 We’ve got the message it will take to win this race.** Restoring reproductive freedom, investing in job creation + industry in Missouri, taking back power for working people... the messages we’ve been able to air statewide on TV are already resonating with voters of all parties, all across the state.
**🔵 Lucas Kunce is within striking distance of Josh Hawley.** Multiple polls show this race is down to just a few points — with a real path to victory.
**🔵 Josh Hawley is officially TERRIFIED.** He knows his record of stripping away our rights, delivering literally $0 for Missouri, and serving no one but himself in the Senate has made him seriously vulnerable this year.
**🔵 Hawley’s campaign + Super PAC have launched an onslaught of attacks** — spending over $5 million since August to air false TV attack ads about Lucas and $0 to tout ANYTHING about Hawley’s accomplishments in the Senate.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. **New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

We’re now inside the final month of this campaign.

We’re fighting for secure borders, affordable groceries and gas, safe neighborhoods, and a government that puts Americans FIRST again.

We can only achieve those things with a Republican House Majority, which will be won or lost here in NM-02 – **THE most competitive seat in the country.**

Friend, Absentee ballots have begun mailing in Michigan, meaning that every day is Election Day between now and November 5th. Our campaign team is working to ensure a massive voter turnout, including reaching voters who voted in 2008 or 2016 but didn’t cast a ballot in 2020. We’re also reaching out to first-time voters and folks who have requested an absentee ballot but have not yet returned it. Hi friends,
Nobody could ever accuse Pete Stauber of being quiet, but you’ll notice that he barely ever talks about his record. And honestly, it’s not surprising — with a terrible track record for Minnesota families, it’s no wonder that he would rather lie and spread misinformation.
In his time in office, he’s delivered for the one constituency that he cares about: rich and powerful special interests. Now, those folks are repaying the favor by flooding our district with dark money, and we need your help to fight back. Every donation makes a real difference to help us get over the finish line in these final few weeks — please chip in anything you can today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241009]

Stauber’s laundry list of failures seems to be never-ending:
Stauber has consistently voted against legislation that would bring critical federal funding right here to rural Minnesota, claiming we “can’t afford it” while supporting huge handouts for ultra-rich corporations. He’s attacked our unions and their right to organize for better pay, voted against lowering prescription drug costs and even voted against providing healthcare for our veterans exposed to toxic burn pits in wars overseas.
Don’t let the lies fool you — Pete Stauber is an anti-choice extremist who believes our government has a right to come between women and their doctors. He’s downplayed the January 6 Insurrection and supported overturning the 2020 election: to our opponent, elections are only legitimate if his side wins.
We can do a lot better, and we have a great chance to “unseat Pete” in just a few weeks — but it’s going to take a whole lot of hard work and your grassroots donations to run a strong campaign through Election Day.
Please rush a grassroots donation to help Jen win this thing so we can pave a better way forward for Minnesota! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-october-2024?refcode=20241009]
Let’s win this thing,
Team Schultz

As the climate crisis intensifies, so do its threats to sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR). Natural disasters, forced migration, and environmental degradation disproportionately affect women and girls, limiting access to essential health care and increasing vulnerability to violence. Partnering with civil society organizations throughout the world, the Center is:
* **Advocating at the United Nations** to strengthen norms and create greater accountability for SRHR violations related to climate change and environmental racism.
* **Providing expert guidance** to governments and local organizations seeking to ensure SRHR in responding to climate change.
* **Tackling toxic chemical exposure** and its impact on SRHR across Latin America.
* **Leveraging regional human rights mechanisms** to hold states accountable, including litigating an environmental case before the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights (IACHR).

🔗 [Learn more about how climate change threatens reproductive rights](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94655230/504206945/-1530299531?sourceid=1149889&utm_campaign=25emgfl-1001aab-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjc0YWY3My04ODg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MoNzWiUa6ITaV9-kD0TG18eSK2yWTMH-fKBhLXqVSQM=&emci=c874af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d274af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

Poland's near-total abortion ban continues to draw international scrutiny. A three-year investigation conducted by the UN Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) condemned the country's actions, highlighting the severe impact on women's rights. The Center is at the forefront of efforts to hold Poland accountable. The CEDAW inquiry into Poland’s abortion law was initiated after submissions by the Center for Reproductive Rights, in collaboration with Polish civil society organizations including the Foundation for Women and Family Planning (FEDERA) and the Karat Coalition. 🔗 [Read about our work on abortion rights in Poland](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94655234/504206949/1218071272?sourceid=1149889&utm_campaign=25emgfl-1001aab-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjc0YWY3My04ODg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MoNzWiUa6ITaV9-kD0TG18eSK2yWTMH-fKBhLXqVSQM=&emci=c874af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d274af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

In 2022, the U.S. Supreme Court stripped away the constitutional right to abortion—a shocking reversal of a fundamental liberty. But a year before that, in 2021, Texas set the stage with S.B. 8, one of the country’s most extreme abortion bans. Now, three years later, the devastating effects of this law are more evident than ever. Vigilante laws like S.B. 8 have been enacted in other states, and currently [14 states prohibit abortion entirely](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94655238/504206953/1777352126?sourceid=1149889&utm_campaign=25emgfl-1001aab-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjc0YWY3My04ODg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MoNzWiUa6ITaV9-kD0TG18eSK2yWTMH-fKBhLXqVSQM=&emci=c874af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d274af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237). **With your support, we continue to fight for every person's right to make decisions about their own body.** This fight is at the heart of _[Zurawski v Texas](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94655239/504206954/-1895356988?sourceid=1149889&utm_campaign=25emgfl-1001aab-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjc0YWY3My04ODg2LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MoNzWiUa6ITaV9-kD0TG18eSK2yWTMH-fKBhLXqVSQM=&emci=c874af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=d274af73-8886-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237), _a documentary that follows the story of three women who, alongside the Center, sued the state of Texas after being denied abortion care during life-threatening pregnancy complications. clean_body: Why aren’t more people talking about state legislative races?! | | 🚨 Urgent: 27 days until Election Day! = | = Here’s something that’ll keep you up at night: Right now, Republicans control 57 of the country’s 99 state legislative chambers. Even more alarming? They have veto-proof majorities in 20 states, giving them unchecked power to override governors and push through extreme, anti-climate, and authoritarian legislation. With Congress gridlocked, state legislatures have become the real power centers for shaping policy. It was state lawmakers who packed courts with conservative judges, laying the groundwork for Roe v. Wade’s reversal. And now, those same states — like Florida, Texas, and Arizona — are using their power to: ban the use of public funds to fight climate change, erase mentions of climate change from state law, and expand fossil fuel projects. It all started with state-level action. And in 27 days, voters like you will decide who holds that power.= At JanePAC, we’re laser-focused on building climate caucuses in state legislatures. In places like Arizona, Michigan, and Pennsylvania, just a few seats could change everything. Check out the map below to see where we’re investing our resources in these final 27 days: = SWING STATE HIGHLIGHT In Arizona , we have the chance to flip the legislature to a pro-climate majority for the first time in decades. Arizona is already feeling the harsh impacts of the climate crisis, and these elections could decide the state's future for generations to come. In Michigan , Democrats are fighting to hold on to their slim majority in the State House — a majority that’s helped pass critical climate legislation over the last year. But Republicans are determined to take back control and undo that progress. Every race here is a nail-biter. In Pennsylvania , a split legislature has stalled critical climate action for too long. body:
Their ad blitz proves to be working too — with five recent polls showing this race tightening to within the margin of error, and the Cook Political Report downgrading our race from “Leans Democrat” to “Toss Up.”

| Hi Peter —

Our campaign just made a risky decision to launch new ads — _even though the money wasn’t originally in our budget._

It wasn’t a decision we made lightly. But it was a necessary one.

My opponent and dark money super PACs are outspending our campaign on the airwaves and have been relentlessly targeting me with misleading attack ads. _Just turn on any TV in Wisconsin and you’ll know what I’m talking about..._

THE PIPELINE DECEPTION
They are Putting Us All at Risk–
Let’s Stop It Now
Dear Peter,
**I’m reaching out with an urgent message about a crisis unfolding in Iowa** —a crisis that threatens to spread nationwide. This is about government overreach into our land, our homes, and our lives.
Iowa is ground zero for a colossal scam: a scheme to force dangerous CO2 pipelines through the heartland of America, all under the guise of “green energy.” But let’s be clear—there’s nothing green about it.
Watch [_**The Pipeline Deception**_](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_9_24_all_1&n=5) to see the truth behind this corporate land grab. You’ll hear from farmers and families on the front lines—people who’ve spent their lives nurturing their land, only to see it threatened by bureaucrats and billionaires.
[Watch Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_9_24_all_1&n=6)
**Kamala Harris** cast the deciding vote to launch this nationwide scheme, and the Biden administration is pushing to expand it to nearly 90,000 miles of pipeline. They’re using eminent domain to seize private land, forcing CO2 pipelines onto farms and into our communities, regardless of the dangers.
**This is personal for me.** I’ve spent my life defending real environmental causes—our water, air, and soil. But this? It’s an environmental nightmare disguised as progress.
President Trump and I agree. We understand the urgent need to protect our land and our rights, and he’s committed to stopping this pipeline deception once and for all. **But to do that, we need to ensure he is elected, so we can have leaders who will defend American families, not corporate interests.**
[**Time is running out, and I need your support today. Will you stand with us against this dangerous pipeline invasion?**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_9_24_all_1&n=7)
[Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_9_24_all_1&n=8)
[**Your urgent donation**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-pipeline?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pipeline_10_9_24_all_1&n=9) will help us stop these projects from tearing apart our communities. Every dollar counts. This fight goes beyond one pipeline—it’s about saving our nation from being sold off to the highest bidder.
Together, with President Trump, we can protect the America we love and secure it for generations to come.
| |

Peter,
On the rolling hills overlooking the seemingly infinite horizon of the Pacific Ocean, stand the centuries-old redwood forests of [Sonoma Coast Redwoods](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94656676/504211821/-651014446?contactdata=UAPZq3/LQjWv+ZL1zYi+1dAXAT7RJ9dz8aAf/QQvFB5oGoYgV1h2qg1lsaib9zL0ojTSlLOuP7Am8d8DPVdkSuFn7KGTJT2Wy8jdAk67pMCS3jnYs88wbBLvIkAaH3DJELcaIJWSqBrov1lsHTSWeJzF/TXVmWMNkxvWZwOP+XA=&ms=SCR4_Link1&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc1MWEyMGYyLThhODYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1U3aU6OVcuyl31KItJxSqMCL0gN9n3Gsa6pqYHYnrPM=&emci=89d93023-b185-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=751a20f2-8a86-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1504551).
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94656677/504211826/-2057046435?contactdata=UAPZq3/LQjWv+ZL1zYi+1dAXAT7RJ9dz8aAf/QQvFB5oGoYgV1h2qg1lsaib9zL0ojTSlLOuP7Am8d8DPVdkSuFn7KGTJT2Wy8jdAk67pMCS3jnYs88wbBLvIkAaH3DJELcaIJWSqBrov1lsHTSWeJzF/TXVmWMNkxvWZwOP+XA=&ms=SCR4_Img1&sourceid=1165968&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc1MWEyMGYyLThhODYtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1U3aU6OVcuyl31KItJxSqMCL0gN9n3Gsa6pqYHYnrPM=&emci=89d93023-b185-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=751a20f2-8a86-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1504551)
Sonoma Coast Redwoods lies along a serene stretch of California coast, where lush redwoods and sweeping ocean views create a constant risk of development. Photo by M3 Creative
Here, the vibrant and lush redwood forests look out over the ocean. Animals like the Sonoma tree vole scurry in the shade of towering redwoods, and red-tailed hawks soar overhead through the salty coastal fog. Every part of this forest — each tree, rock, animal, and plant — has a story to tell.
We have a chance to ensure those stories are told. Future generations should be able to benefit and enjoy this stunning and iconic landscape.
