clean_body: The story of a landscape on the Sonoma Coast Peter, On the rolling hills overlooking the seemingly infinite horizon of the Pacific Ocean, stand the centuries-old redwood forests of . Sonoma Coast Redwoods lies along a serene stretch of California coast, where lush redwoods and sweeping ocean views create a constant risk of development. Photo by M3 Creative Here, the vibrant and lush redwood forests look out over the ocean. Animals like the Sonoma tree vole scurry in the shade of towering redwoods, and red-tailed hawks soar overhead through the salty coastal fog. Every part of this forest — each tree, rock, animal, and plant — has a story to tell. We have a chance to ensure those stories are told. Georgia Young, League director of development, stands amid coast redwood trees at Sonoma Coast Redwoods. By preventing further commercial harvest and restoring this maturing forest, we can lock in crucial climate benefits for the long term. Photo by Max Forster The California coastline is primed for development because of the million-dollar views. There are those who would love to build homes and estates up here for that reason. But development would harm this fragile habitat and the unique beauty of the Sonoma Coast Redwoods. We have other plans. Fog rolls in across the Sonoma Coast Redwoods property, more than half of which is covered by a healthy coast redwood forest. Photo by M3 Creative This landscape is rich in history and culture as it lies within the ancestral territory of the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians. Sonoma Coast Redwoods is also of the highest conservation priority due to these redwoods’ ability to store vast amounts of carbon. Panoramic views extend across the famed Highway 1 to adjacent Fort Ross State Historic Park. The acquisition of Sonoma Coast Redwoods would create an exciting opportunity to expand the California Coastal Trail through breathtaking scenery. Photo by Max Forster In 2020, Sonoma Coast Redwoods partially burned during the Meyers Fire. Some of the oldest redwoods survived, now standing side-by-side with redwood seedlings planted to aid the forests’ recovery. Today, you can see resilience and regrowth on this iconic landscape and it fills me with hope. The proximity of Fort Ross, with its weathered redwood structures, historic cemetery, and coastal trails, creates a unique opportunity to expand recreational access along the California coast. Photo by Zug Zwang Protecting Sonoma Coast Redwoods would ensure its beauty, ecological and cultural resources, fire resilience, and carbon capacity are secured. It would also provide a critical buffer to the redwood forest of Fort Ross State Historic Park and could lead to expanded public access. Future generations should be able to benefit and enjoy this stunning and iconic landscape. Let’s look toward that infinite horizon together and build a future where rare and wild spaces like this are preserved. Thank you for putting your love of forests into action. | Adrianna Andreucci Land Protection Manager ---|--- P.S. Our $1 Million Match is ongoing until December 31st! Thank you! | ---|--- Connect with us | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

It’s me, Royce White, former college basketball superstar and current professional basketball player, with an urgent message for you. [**Before you read it, will you donate $25 or more to my campaign?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=eb54d0e17f68421ca2b77f5002747623&_e=16bkaAtSj99UWFSaxZDS2vBLZ-u5fPhooJ1SCCr2JpcKIzeTH7FRPNuqo2MIXZP775XhYUBoUpPFFw1tCFP3T21o1MIS2hXSMWW3eUyZX29r8XHTsCgJVgWl-kvcO4roUUDiTdEdsudFby3ZS9aA55c3-t-IYhDHC6HmYvJslTlT4wG4aQDM-_IQr67OSB_tLvjLq9_FQwefNe0-RYNdHujVQIshGZL-A2KOQJPVqkCxkVncRqXOHrNkb2p3pSRJqHKJBUBspoLYDY1in8N_mchFOKv9VvVsDIzGctjMiuOzK5LYMqUyudR-FeGdDg-E91OmeKrSN8Q5IiZBaOtS5Q%3D%3D)

I will never put my morals and principles second to ANYTHING in life. I’m outspoken and I’m a fighter.

Even when the Industrial Media Complex drags my name through the mud for my beliefs, I’ll never back down.

That’s the mentality I’m bringing to my campaign for the U.S. Senate.

I know I have unorthodox opinions. I know I’m outspoken. I know I curse and go on tangents to deliver nuance and substance when I should be “message-disciplined.”

But I do it because that’s what America needs – a new, young voice in the Senate to combat the complacency that’s been engulfing Washington, D.C. While my Radical Leftist Opponent, Amy Klobuchar, lines her pockets from Deep State Swamp Interests, I’m out here fighting and campaigning to lead my America-First Movement.

_I can’t fire Amy Klobuchar without you, though._

**The election is LESS THAN A MONTH AWAY,** and I’m still fighting off the Mainstream Media’s lies and attacks while trying to reach out to undecided voters.

**That said, my FINAL End-of-Month Deadline before the election is on Halloween, October 31st.** This is my FINAL CHANCE to make up ground with my fundraising, which allows me to place TV ad buys to make sure that undecided voters can hear my uncensored message.

[**Can you chip in just $25 before midnight to help me get back on pace to hit my EOM projections?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=eb54d0e17f68421ca2b77f5002747623&_e=16bkaAtSj99UWFSaxZDS2vBLZ-u5fPhooJ1SCCr2JpcKIzeTH7FRPNuqo2MIXZP775XhYUBoUpPFFw1tCFP3T21o1MIS2hXSMWW3eUyZX29r8XHTsCgJVgWl-kvcO4roUUDiTdEdsudFby3ZS9aA55c3-t-IYhDHC6HmYvJslTlT4wG4aQDM-_IQr67OSB_tNogabHBVzIL3fs5s93B0Z2XpnT2MJbgzWFvX6hqm0imTOwyyxKJvNaGgXIcVBy8f-Jk_F5WoLSFiWqtkCJqZwcDu0qQFFGIEgYhPfN1F4Ov3UOuDRPPK8ol3NbqQu9a_Kwr6wQRAT3ZS-hM22kTmLg%3D%3D)

If I come up short, I won’t have enough money to reach out to undecided voters.

**Just look around today.** You’ll see countless stories about 11 million illegal immigrants flooding our country, constant foreign wars that America is involving itself in, and grocery and gas prices that would’ve seemed unthinkable just four years ago.

_If that isn’t reason enough to donate a few bucks and get America back on track, I don’t know what else to say._

[**So please, I’m humbly asking, will you donate $25 before midnight?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=eb54d0e17f68421ca2b77f5002747623&_e=16bkaAtSj99UWFSaxZDS2vBLZ-u5fPhooJ1SCCr2JpcKIzeTH7FRPNuqo2MIXZP775XhYUBoUpPFFw1tCFP3T21o1MIS2hXSMWW3eUyZX29r8XHTsCgJVgWl-kvcO4roUUDiTdEdsudFby3ZS9aA55c3-t-IYhDHC6HmYvJslTlT4wG4aQDM-_IQr67OSB_tfOmUFae-ih5HuYtyPdHOvmEa5yL-9RGXgGfZ_UrD_KsdIczuCokoJpmP8PdEdl4q2Q98LdUVyyMWlB2B9rLBctQ0IRBL2IVNdCXIeC2aMAIyTwngibPozM-LbCoQlifkzxypoZ3XO7v0DT30aYPOxw%3D%3D)

Talk soon,

Royce White

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Wow, can you believe it? Even Ohio’s own Republican Governor, Mike DeWine, is fed up with the chaos Trump and his cronies like Jim Jordan are unleashing on our communities.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241009_springfield_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241009_springfield_image]
Just last week, DeWine called out Trump and J.D. Vance for terrorizing Springfield with their lies and fearmongering.
When a Republican Governor is this disgusted with the conduct of his own party, you know it’s bad.
I’ve been out in the district every single day, talking to people of all walks of life. Over and over again I hear about how Jim Jordan’s lies and constant chaos are hurting our country.
The other day my team and I were in Jordan’s hometown and stopped to get something to eat before heading home. Our waitress got to talking with us and as soon as she learned I’m running against Jim Jordan she lit up .
She told us she’s a proud Republican but she has absolutely had ENOUGH of Jim Jordan, J.D. Vance, and Donald Trump spreading lies and trashing her hometown.
She talked about the bomb threats, the schools and City Hall having to shut down and the awful media attention and said:
“It’s completely ruined our city. I can’t believe a Presidential and Vice-Presidential nominee would say such horrible things, they’re idiots.”
And she’s right. The lies and hatred ULTRA-MAGA Republicans like Jim Jordan are spreading are hurting real people right here in Ohio. And JD Vance is OUR senator!
We have 27 days to make sure people see Jim Jordan for who he is – a conspiracy theory-pushing Trump lapdog who has never authored a bill that’s passed in 17 years to help the American people. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241009_springfield_link1]
Early voting is now underway, and every dollar helps counteract the lies and ensure every voter knows the truth about Jordan’s chaos. Can you contribute $20, $50, or whatever you can today to help us make it happen? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241009_springfield_link2]
This is the most important congressional race in the country because we have a chance to send Jordan packing for good.
He has spent years aiding and abetting Trump’s extremist agenda.
He dismisses Trump’s dictator fantasies like it’s a joke – because, to him, it is.
He’s happy to play along as long as it means he can keep climbing the ladder of ULTRA-MAGA power.
And when the tough questions come, like his involvement in the OSU sexual abuse scandal, he runs away.
It’s a pattern – he supports authoritarianism and hides from accountability.
If Jordan really cared about Ohio, he wouldn’t repeat these dangerous lies himself or stand with candidates who trash our communities.
He wouldn’t dismiss the real harm Trump and Vance are causing.
And he wouldn’t run from the OSU scandal like a coward.
But that’s exactly who he is.
This is our chance to expose him for the fraud he is and show Jordan what real leadership looks like – supporting our communities, protecting our values, and building a better future for America.
We need every single one of you.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. Julie regularly used her local swimming pool that is owned by the City of Port Townsend and operated by the YMCA._But what happened next Julie never saw coming!_ After a typical swim at the YMCA pool, Julie went to the women's locker room to shower like she always does.But Julie was surprised to hear a male's voice while she was showering.Alarmed, Julie pulled back the curtain to see what on earth was going on!To her shock, she saw a fully grown man wearing a woman's bathing suit and watching two little girls undress!Friend, this story is so gut wrenching I'm sorry I must share it with you. . . **But now the radical left is trying to ruin Julie's future because she stood up for those two little girls -- and Julie is relying on your help.** The two little girls appeared to be about 4 and 6 years old. Julie believed she was witnessing a predator take advantage of these innocent girls! So Julie did what any grandmother in that situation would do -- she confronted the man and asked him to leave the bathroom!Friend, our country relies on selfless people like Julie to keep our children safe in the face of the danger and perversion the left seems to be rapidly welcoming into our communities. But instead of thanking Julie for looking out for those innocent girls, the staff at the YMCA rushed in and began berating Julie for her "_discriminatory"_ response to the predator.What is discriminatory about asking a man to stop watching little girls undress?!**_Absolutely nothing!_** Then the YMCA claimed this selfless grandmother mistreated a grown man who "identifies" as a woman.This response is nothing but insane!!_But it gets worse . . ._ Not only did the YMCA attack Julie for protecting two innocent children, it also permanently banned Julie from swimming at that pool! _. . . and they called the police to kick Julie out of the building . . . __. . . then they launched a sophisticated smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and a transphobe in her community._ This story seems too outrageous to be true. In a society where truth and justice are so often trampled, I'd like to share with you this story of a selfless grandmother standing up for what is right . . . and the left's mission to take her down. Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who's lived in Port Townsend, Washington, for almost forty years. Julie regularly used her local swimming pool that is owned by the City of Port Townsend and operated by the YMCA.But what happened next Julie never saw coming! After a typical swim at the YMCA pool, Julie went to the women's locker room to shower like she always does.But Julie was surprised to hear a male's voice while she was showering.Alarmed, Julie pulled back the curtain to see what on earth was going on!To her shock, she saw a fully grown man wearing a woman's bathing suit and watching two little girls undress!Friend, this story is so gut wrenching I'm sorry I must share it with you. . . But now the radical left is trying to ruin Julie's future because she stood up for those two little girls -- and Julie is relying on your help. The two little girls appeared to be about 4 and 6 years old. Julie believed she was witnessing a predator take advantage of these innocent girls! So Julie did what any grandmother in that situation would do -- she confronted the man and asked him to leave the bathroom!Friend, our country relies on selfless people like Julie to keep our children safe in the face of the danger and perversion the left seems to be rapidly welcoming into our communities. But instead of thanking Julie for looking out for those innocent girls, the staff at the YMCA rushed in and began berating Julie for her "discriminatory" response to the predator.What is discriminatory about asking a man to stop watching little girls undress?!Absolutely nothing! Then the YMCA claimed this selfless grandmother mistreated a grown man who "identifies" as a woman.This response is nothing but insane!!But it gets worse . . . Not only did the YMCA attack Julie for protecting two innocent children, it also permanently banned Julie from swimming at that pool! . . . and they called the police to kick Julie out of the building . . . . . . then they launched a sophisticated smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and a transphobe in her community. This story seems too outrageous to be true. But sadly it is. And without your help, Julie will live the rest of her life banned from the pool she used almost daily to stay active. If Americans like you don't stand with Julie today, truth and justice in our country will be gone forever.I can't imagine an America where grandmothers are the subject of a political witch hunt for protecting little girls from sexual predators! That's why the Center for American Liberty is doing everything it can to fight for justice for Julie!My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm an attorney and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize my colleagues or me from our frequent appearances on Fox News, Newsmax, Tucker Carlson, Fox and Friends, and others.Together with patriots like you, the Center for American Liberty helps everyday citizens beat the radical Left in court! And now we are taking on the radicals at the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend. Because Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind no matter who disagrees.Julie also has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process.But if the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend have their way, Julie will be denied both of her fundamental rights. And worst of all . . . if we don't win this fight in court, the YMCA and City of Port Townsend will continue getting away with this behavior. Your donation today will send a strong message that we will not be silenced. . . we will not allow the left to erase women and endanger children! Sadly, the well-funded ACLU and other dark left money groups will join the YMCA's side, undoubtedly. While settling in, I was looking for a way to get involved and plug into my new community during this critical political moment when I found the Working Families Party. I signed up to canvass with the Pennsylvania WFP even though I wasn’t sure what to expect, and honestly, I was nervous. But once I was out knocking on doors, it was incredibly energizing. Not only did I get to meet some really great people in my new neighborhood, but I also saw firsthand how powerful face-to-face conversations can be in mobilizing voters and driving change. **Getting out to talk with voters in Philly helps me turn my anxiety about this election into action that can make a difference. In fact, I just got back from my third shift!** If (like me!) you’ve ever thought about getting involved but felt unsure about where to start — don’t worry! | Peter,

In CA-38, over 60% of our community identifies as Latino—and I’m proud to be part of that heritage!

Together, we’ve overcome obstacles within our community, like unfair working conditions, unequal access to quality education, little representation in government, and more.

_But our fight is far from over._

**Latinas still earn just 51 cents for every dollar earned by white, non-Hispanic men, costing Latino families on average $1.2 million a lifetime. DACA recipients still do not have a guaranteed pathway to citizenship. And the rise of extremism, discrimination, and hate have taken a toll on our communities.**

That’s why I committed to uplifting the Hispanic community, especially with this year’s election 3 weeks away. As the Chair of BOLD PAC, the campaign arm of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, it is my top priority to elect progressive Latinos who will stand up for our rights.

Let’s honor our heritage not just by celebrating our past but by fighting for our future—one where all of us have the opportunity to thrive.

Linda **💙**

He’s been a politician his entire life, and now he’s using millions of dollars to try and bury us and get another six years in the Senate. This race isn’t just about me vs. Sherrod. It’s about YOU vs. the radical left machine that wants to turn America into a socialist nightmare – where open borders, anarchy, and government control are the new normal. Your support can’t wait. We’re less than a month away from Election Day, and EARLY VOTING HAS ALREADY BEGUN! Thank you for being in this fight with me, Bernie Moreno GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.
